I saw her trade away all her money and books for a literal truckload of the things in another reality earlier.  Not sure what she does with them.  You see, she's lined her private rooms with lead which just so happens to block my scrying.  Almost like she doesn't trust me.  Not sure why.
I see a giant ant cutting down a tree wi: 我看到了一只巨大的蚂蚁用她的下颚砍倒一棵树。你知道工蚁都是雌性吗？她身边还有许多同伴朋友。给我一个第纳尔，我就帮你在地图上标出那个地方。
我现在可给不出那么多钱。
I see a giant ant lobbing globs of acids: 我看到一只巨大的蚂蚁向一群可怜的狗吐酸球。这似乎很有效。给我一个第纳尔，我就帮你在地图上标出那个地方。
Why would you ever want to get close to: 你为什么想要接近那些生物？难道你不知道它们在其他生物体内产卵吗？包括人类！好吧，如果你确定要去，我就在地图上标出那个地方，只要给我一个第纳尔。但假如你被灌满了寄生虫幼虫可别哭着找我。说真的，别来。我还想留着我的午餐。如果它们确实给你带来了麻烦，你会发现喝点艾草油会有所帮助。是用，嗯，艾草，和油做的吧，我想是的。
Spiders it is then. But of course, ther: Spiders it is then.  But of course, there are several different kinds of spiders out there.  Which type are you interested in?
I see a grove covered in webs. And legs: 我看到一片被蛛网覆盖的小树林。还有腿，好多腿。给我一个第纳尔，我就帮你在地图上标出位置。别把它们带回来就行了。
There is a burrow not too far away that: 不远的地方有一个洞，里面爬满了蜘蛛。大概是吧，我没有仔细看。我也不打算这么做。给我一个第纳尔，我就在地图上帮你标出位置。
Fascinating creatures, really. They hav: 真是迷人的生物。它们已经进化出可以将天生魔力转化为强大的火焰法术的能力。一些恶魔蜘蛛女王也会收集魔法物品。也许他们有办法吸收其中的魔力并为自己所用？给我一个第纳尔，我就帮你在地图上标出巢穴位置。你最好带上防火服。
No thanks. Giant fire-breathing spiders: 不，谢谢。巨型喷火蜘蛛可不是闹着玩的。
Ah yes, the extradimensional fungal disp: 啊，是的，被称为马卡斯的超维度真菌分散智能体。我告诉你，它们对跨维度旅行者来说是一个相当大的威胁。有些人把他们视为神。有些人将其视为生死存亡的威胁。还有一些人认为它们是植物纤维的良好来源。它们的细胞结构使它们高度适应各种各样的现实世界，就像其他真菌生命形式一样。如果你发现自己被感染了，而且没有抗真菌药物，你可以试着在皮肤上擦硫磺。它可能不起作用，也可能刺激你的皮肤，但任何事情都比让它顺其自然要好。如果药物治疗失败了，别费心让子弹穿过你的脑袋。这并不能把你从迫在眉睫的命运中拯救出来。取而代之的是用火，这是我的建议。现在，马卡斯有几种不同的表现形式。你对哪一个感兴趣？
On second thought, maybe I'll go for som: 转念一想，我们还是谈点别的吧。
I can almost smell them through the crys: 我甚至能透过水晶球闻到它们的味道，真是令人不安。给我一个第纳尔，我就在地图上标出这个地方。祝你好运。
Scrying on these things makes me uneasy,: 探知这些东西让我浑身不舒服，但只要给我一个第纳尔，我就帮你标出位置。
I can't even number the times I've scrap: 我都记不清有多少次从熔炉上刮掉这些东西了。这就像以每秒50米的速度走进一张蜘蛛网，而且这蜘蛛网很难闻，想要吃掉你。至少锻造大师安装的魔法火炬有点帮助。马卡斯害怕火，这就说得清了。总之，只要给我一个第纳尔，我就帮你标出位置。记住了：别吃那里的任何东西，无论它们有多诱人。
对，来自太空的真菌甲壳类动物。要我说，这真是讨厌的家伙——啊哦，别告诉他们。铸造大师说他们没有冒犯的意思......把人砍成碎片只是他们打招呼的方式。就我个人而言，这很粗鲁，但也许这是我的人类中心主义。
我离题了。你对营地还是侦察塔感兴趣?？
Have you seen mi-go architecture? They: 你看过那些米·戈建筑吗？它们用树脂建造出那些活生生的有机结构。挺酷的，而且令人不安，我想。当然，如果你盯着它看太久，它们会把你切成碎片的。只要给我一个第纳尔，我就帮你标出位置。我听过一个故事，不知道是真是假，但据说一个人试图用那种树脂制造盔甲。不出意料，它扎进了那个可怜的家伙的肉里！就像地衣一样！他的朋友们试图把它扯下来，但它毫发无损。他非常痛苦，他们决定结束他的痛苦。但他们做不到，因为盔甲太好了！所以我想，从某种意义上说，它起效了。呵呵。偶尔，脑海中的画面仍然会让我晚上睡不着觉。现在你也有画面了吧，不用谢。
我谢谢你，我真的谢谢你。
The mi-go seem to abduct humans and anim: 米·戈似乎为了某种怪异的目的而绑架人类和动物，然后建造这些塔，让它们的宇宙飞船停靠，以便将囚犯送出地球。我提过他们有宇宙飞船吗？嗯，虽然我从未真正见过飞船停靠在塔上，但依然如此。我可以为你在地图上标记这样一座塔的位置，代价是一枚第纳尔。
Right. Extradimensional intelligent pla: Right.  Extradimensional intelligent plants with a mean streak.  They seem to have a method of traveling from reality to reality without traversing the hazards between.  Interesting, no?  I'd ask them how they do it but I don't think I could get a word in edgewise before they cut me to pieces.  I'll mark one of their groves on your map for one denarius.
It seems that a group of mutated cephalo: 看起来一群变异章鱼在水边的洞穴里扎营了。我不知道它们在干什么，但如果你想去调查一下，只要一个第纳尔，我就在地图上给你标上位置。
Do you like slime? Do you like living s: 你喜欢变形怪吗？你喜欢想要吃你的活生生的变形怪吗？你希望自己被很多很多很多的变形怪包围吗？那也许那里就是你的归宿。只要给我一个第纳尔，我就能在地图上标出位置。
Good choice. It seems that shortly befo: Good choice.  It seems that shortly before the world started to end, a few of them got it in their heads to just leave civilization alone for a bit and go live in the woods with other goblins.  And wargs.  Not a terrible idea if you ask me.  Anyways, there's a few different types of places they gather, are you looking for an encampment or an outpost?
You've got a long walk deep into the for: You've got a long walk deep into the forest ahead of you.  Oh, and did I mention the wargs?  They've got these wargs that are absolutely adorable.  Of course they'll maul you if you try to pet them, but the temptation is always there.  I'll mark one of their camps on your map for one denarius.
Contrary to popular belief, goblins are: Contrary to popular belief, goblins are not actually orcs.  Its the other way around.  Orcs are goblins who have taken one too many unlabeled potions and lived to tell the tale.  Sometimes this awakens powers much like my own.  Well, not exactly, if it did I'd be out of a job faster than a Magus could cast Phase Door.  Luckily for you, you shouldn't have to delve too deep into a forest to see for yourself.  I'll mark one of their outposts on your map for one denarius.
Oh, fancy yourself a dragon slayer, eh?: 哦，想当屠龙者，嗯？据我了解，它们会喷酸，所以要为此做好准备。而且记住，龙的浑身都是宝，甚至血液也不例外，所以你可能想带点东西装血，并记得在你完全屠宰之前给尸体放血。只要给我一个第纳尔，我就帮你标出它巢穴的位置。
Now there is not a lot I can tell you ab: 现在关于这个，我能告诉你的不多。这个山洞里住着某种恶魔兽。但它只是偶尔浮出水面，洞穴墙壁上的重金属干扰了我的占卜结果。那里可能有宝藏，也可能没有。但肯定充满了危险。只要给我一个第纳尔，我就帮你标出位置。
Deeply buried secret installations where: Deeply buried secret installations where shady government organizations conducted unethical experiments, free from moral constrains.  Did such places really exist before the Cataclysm, or did humanity's collective mistrust, superstition and conspiracy theories cause the portal storms to dream these places into existence?  I honestly can't tell, but I suppose it doesn't matter now.  These places do exist, and are ripe with mysteries, dangers, and loot.  You'll have to specify which kind you're looking for.
Right. Probably a good call. I'll mark: 对。也许是个好主意。只要给我一个第纳尔，我就帮你在地图上标出位置。
Here it seems like the scientists manage: 科学家们似乎成功地打通了现世与异界。当然，他们就没想过安全流程，所以这整个地方变得一团糟。如果你去那里，要当心面对燃烧之眼。只要给我一个第纳尔，我就帮你标出位置。
Fellow travelers between realities, thos: 在不同现实世界之间穿行的同伴旅行者，那群人。起初我以为他们会是竞争对手，但他们似乎对我们熔炉所重视的东西兴趣不大。如今，我们很少与他们互动，除了在极少数情况下，当我们发现他们被困在两个世界之间会伸手帮一把。几乎每次在我们可以救援时，这群可怜人快被完全逼疯了。尽管如此，对瓦尔赞而言，这就是海洋的法则。他们似乎在离这里不远的地方开了家店。只要给我一个第纳尔，我就会在你的地图上标出位置。在你出发之前，你也许会想去魔法物品商店看看有没有通晓语言护符买。但话说回来，我们现在可能已经卖光了。
Yes, a strange location indeed, buried m: 是的，确实是一个奇怪的地方，大部分埋在地下。它真的是人类建造的吗？我觉得这不太可能。我看不清建筑的深处，但在入口下方的某个地方有股奇怪的力量。只要给我一个第纳尔，我就在地图上给你标上位置。
You know, if you've got the aptitude, yo: You know, if you've got the aptitude, you should go visit an attunement altar.  They help you combine your skills with different classes of magic to incredible effect.  I'll mark one on your map for one denarius.
This place used to teach magic before th: This place used to teach magic before the whole Malignance business.  There are probably still spell scrolls and magical items to find there.  And golems.  Can't forget about the golems.  I'll mark one on your map for one denarius.
Seems like an eccentric wizard once live: Seems like an eccentric wizard once lived here.  Not that there are any other kind of wizards, am I right?  But, uh, don't tell Valzain I said so.  Or any other wizards for that matter.  But you know it's true.  Anyways, I'll mark the building on your map for one denarius.
Poor druids, they were hit hardest by th: Poor druids, they were hit hardest by the rise of technology.  Magi, technomancers, animists, they can just close the windows and keep their chanting low so to not bother the neighbors.  Even earthshapers can just go into the backyard, but druids had to move out to the middle of nowhere.  That's where their tower will be, mind.  There won't be a road there, so you're in for quite the trip.  I'll mark one on your map for one denarius.
I could use a nice walk.
Rivers. Water, sand, clay, fish, giant: Rivers.  Water, sand, clay, fish, giant mutant bugs.  Generally pretty big.  If you're still having trouble finding one, I'll mark one on your map for one denarius.
Digging clay is quintessential of the Ea: Digging clay is quintessential of the Earthshaper.  Forming it into useful tools is quintessential of the Technomancer.  Showing you where you can find it is quintessential of me. For one denarius of course.
If you're looking for something rough an: 如果你要找的东西既粗又糙还到处都是，我可以在你的地图上标记一处沙地，只要给我一个第纳尔。
The water there is scolding hot. Perhap: 那里的水热得要命。也许它能帮你度过寒冬？只要给我一个第纳尔，我就帮你标出来。
If you're interested in the neolithic ho: 如果你对新石器时代的房地产感兴趣，我可以在地图上标出一个洞穴，只要给我一个第纳尔。只是要注意，可能已经有住客了。
Looking for potion ingredients? I know: 在寻找药剂成分吗？我知道一个地方，魔脉在此交汇，这种植物长得很多。给我一个第纳尔，我在地图上给你标上。
Valzain is in the back, down in the vaul: 瓦尔赞就在后面那个避难所的地下室，正在兜售他那些要价离谱的魔法小玩意儿。或者，你心里其实另有打算？
There is only one Forge of Wonders. It': 奇迹熔炉只有一个。这玩意儿又不是什么多维空间连锁加盟店。
There are these city-sized creatures cal: 有一种城市大小的生物，叫做“虚空利维坦”，生活在不同现实之间的广阔虚空之中。它们有时会“搁浅”在刚刚经历过大灾变的地球上。它们当初可是惹出了各种各样的麻烦，所以瓦尔赞施法让它们改为在地下生成。我可以将一具这种生物搁浅的尸体标记在你的地图上，代价是一枚第纳尔。
The Malignance is the cause for much of: 魔瘤是我们大部分苦难的原因。它是驱动丧尸的力量。它是空间风暴的原因，它似乎充满仇恨。瓦尔赞的理论是，它曾经是自然的基本力量，或者是某种魔法力量，以某种方式获得了意识，或者可能是强加于它的意识。据称，米·戈曾经谈起它存在之前的一个时代，或者可能是一个它还不那么危险的时代。而现在，它在地球上无处不在。据我所知，它没有结构，也没有行动基地，所以我没有地方可以帮你标出来。对不起。
我的冒险经历会让你的血液凝固。
I've killed many a government-sanctioned: 我这辈子杀过很多政府认证过的赏金猎人。
Aren't we all lucky that you are probabl: 你可能是方圆几里内最后一个活着的执法人员，我们难道不都应该感到幸运吗？
Ahoy and other nautical terms!: 啊呵，还有其他的航海术语！
I hope you're willing to overlook my pas: 我希望你能忽视掉我的过去，否则你没法从我这里买到任何东西。
A lifetime of plunder has brought me man: 一辈子到处掠夺给我带来了很多奇怪的东西——而你可以用无与伦比的价格买到！
好吧，吓老子一跳。（注：shiver me timbers）
Do you think me a fool, to tell an offic: Do you think me a fool, to tell an officer of the law my current plans?
Not even trying to ask me that undercove: Not even trying to ask me that undercover?  By the seventeen seas, officers of the law really ARE made worse these days.
The end of times is here and that's what: The end of times is here and that's what you're worried about?  You should get your priorities straight.
Well you obviously aren't an officer so: 好吧，你显然不是什么军官，那咱们就打开天窗说亮话。有艘气派的大帆船会在<restock_time_point>靠岸，到那时我肯定能弄到些好货。
May the seas be ever in your favor.
I am always on the lookout for weapons a: 我总是在到处找寻武器和子弹。我也很乐意帮你摆脱你的那些身外之物。
I created this place from dreams and mag: 我用梦和魔法创造了这个地方。
The government doesn't subsidize your pu: 你的政府可没法再为你在这里的购买行为提供补贴了。
Do you have any tales of adventure I cou: 你有什么冒险故事可以让我写下来吗？
In case you were wondering, we no longer: 如果你想知道的话，我们这里可不尊重任何原有的武器法案。
讲些故事给我听，我们还可以交易。
我有一些故事要告诉你。
Excellent. What new stories have you br: 太棒了。你给我带来了什么新故事？
Once I was lost in the throes of love, n: Once I was lost in the throes of love, now I've built an empire of material goods.  I've found these two things are equally as powerful, and dangerous.
Well here and now I am the law, and the: 好吧，现在我就是法律，这里的法律是人们购买我的商品，他们把它们带去到世界上，然后要么在外面死去；要么回来购买更多商品。不管怎样，我都会为他们写些诗。
My minions are busy putting the final to: 我的仆从们正忙于为几个激动人心的项目做最后的收尾，到<restock_time_point>再回来看看有什么新鲜玩意儿。
Walk away afore I kill ya where you stan: 赶紧在我杀了你之前从我面前滚开。
You've got a lot of nerve wearing that b: 现在这种情况你还敢戴着那枚徽章，真是胆大包天。
兄弟们，我想我们应该淹死这个蠢货。
Obviously I should speak to someone else: 显然我应该和别人谈谈。
I must purge this land of its curse. Wi: 我将清除这片土地的诅咒。你会帮助我们还是阻碍我们？
Blessed be. May you purge that which op: 祝福你。愿你清除那些不平静之物。
I must purge this place before I can mov: 我必须先清理此处之后方能继续前进。
And leave my tower and all my research?: 然后丢下我这座塔和我所有的研究？我还是不要了。
Yes, yes… *electrical crackling* Isn't i: 是的，是的，…… *电流的咔咔声* 是不是很漂亮？
I must find more power before I can leav: 我必须找到更多能量之后方能继续前进。
A beverage made from dragonails. It has: 一种用龙尾藤制成的饮料。它有一种独特且令人不快的味道，会让喉咙发烫。
Goldbrew, made from golden reeds. Smell: 金茅酒，以金色芦苇酿造。散发着对远方的向往与悠远的沉思气息。
Unfermented dragonfire. Made from drago: 未发酵的龙息酒。由龙尾藤酿制而成，这将是一款气味浓烈的饮品。你需要将其放入发酵桶中酿造。
Unfermented goldbrew. Smells like unreq: 未发酵的金茅酒。散发着单相思与无尽渴望的气息。你需要将其放入发酵桶中进行酿造。
发酵过但未蒸馏的龙火酒。基本上必须经过适当蒸馏后才能饮用。
发酵但未蒸馏的金酒。即使未经精炼，这也是一种香气宜人的饮品。

Staff at Johns Hopkins University yesterday announced promising results in the long search for a health catalyst spell.  While an actual prototype formula has not been released, the draft paper indicates that animal testing showed a five percent decrease in long-term mortality rates in rats suffering from a dozen different types of cancers.  "A true universal healing catalyst spell would really be the Holy Grail", said Dr. Olivia k'Ħarzag, Director of Thaumaturgical Oncology Research at Johns Hopkins University. 麻省法师死亡，警方调查不止

近日， 麻省发生了一起神秘的法师死亡案件，死者西维是雷达西氏族赫尔梅的女儿，上个月被发现死于家中。目前，警方正在对此案进行深入调查，尚未发现任何谋杀嫌疑。

据马萨诸塞州总医院验尸官的初步报告显示，西维死于突发性疾病导致的多器官衰竭。然而，知情人士透露，西维的器官状况如同老者，这实在让人惊讶。西维年仅96岁，对于一个侏儒来说，这一年龄还不到中年。

西维的死亡原因引发众人猜测。有传言称，西维或因过度研究急速魔法的效果而导致死亡。有专家表示，急速药可能会对身体施加压力，但这种压力是作为法术效果的一部分来计算的。西维的死亡被认为是一个悲剧，但也有观点认为，对魔法副作用的恐惧并不利于社会的稳定。

麻省理工大学控制肿瘤学教授奥利维亚·赖特（Olivia Wright）在接受记者采访时表示，急速药确实会对身体施加压力，但这种压力是作为法术效果的一部分来计算的。她强调，西维的死是个悲剧，但散布对魔法副作用的恐惧对任何人都没有帮助。

目前，西维的死亡调查仍在继续，警方将竭尽全力查明真相。对于这起案件，我们将持续关注。

\"Musings on Orichalcum\n\nOrichalcum is:
"关于山铜的思考

山铜主要是一种铜基合金，但其制作工艺因人而异，涉及的微量金属和具体程序也各不相同。虽然它的强度远不及钢，但它更耐腐蚀以及普通磨损（有人说这是因为它更愿意保持原始形态）。虽然存在传统古代魔法力量之剑，但许多共识都是基于前工业化时代的人在墓穴中以及类似状态下所发现的山铜武器。那么，为什么我们在工业环境中不使用山铜呢？问题在于，如果没有按照正确步骤锻造，其中所蕴含的魔能会逐渐消散。对于大多数失败品而言，它将以分钟为单位转变（实际上这从一开始就称不上是山铜），但有显著失败风险的时间至少有30年，这意味着成品必须像葡萄酒一样"陈酿"才能被视为真正的山铜。尽管比从头开始锻造要容易一些，但重新锻造现有的山铜也会带来同样的问题，从而阻碍了它的工业化生产，并限制了它的制造用途。你可以在旧盔甲和武器中找到它，也可以在昂贵的传家宝餐具中找到它。现在仍然有一个由爱好者和工匠大师组成的活跃社区，但山铜和许多其他魔法现象一样，整体而言并不适合我们这个现代社会。"

Like the bonfire gathers revelers around: 就像篝火聚集了狂欢者一样，炽霜法师成为了派对的灵魂，他们的眼睛闪耀着激情，声音中燃烧着坚定的热情。生效期间，你会更有说服力。在大灾变之前，这是学徒们渴望学习的常见法术之一，而大师们却不愿意传授。
Just as the kelvinist can start a fire,: 就像炽霜法师可以生火一样，他们也可以通过将火焰的热量直接转化为冰冷，不留下任何让火焰持续的东西，来使其熄灭。
Summon a sphere of ice that will preserv: Summon a sphere of ice that will preserve anything placed inside while the container lasts.
Draw on the essence of ice to freeze out: 凭借冰之精华，冻结所有感情，使你变得惬意地麻木。在那个还重视着这个法术的政府还没崩溃的时候，一旦政府知道你了解这个，你必然会上好几个名单。
A simple spell that hurls a bolt of fire: 一个简单的咒语，向目标位置掷出一道闪电。虽然不像一些更复杂的咒语那样具有破坏性，但它施放速度很快，会点燃目标上的任何易燃物。
With the tiniest amount of heat, unfreez: 用最少量的热量解冻食物或饮料，并将其加热到舒适的温度。
Force a large amount of burning mana int: 将大量燃烧的魔力强制注入每个受法术影响的敌对目标，使其在烈火中爆炸。在大灾变前，了解这个法术需要许可和登记，但现在你很确定 ATF 不会再来找你麻烦了。
The shaman summons a crocodile!: 蜥蜴人萨满召唤出一只鳄鱼！

You focus your mana into a microscopical: 你将你的魔力聚集到一束极薄的纯能量脉冲光束中，具有极高的射程和精度；以及无与伦比的穿透力，只要技能等级足够。这个法术曾经是一名臭名昭著的刺客的发明，曾经杀死了无数国王和贵族。它只通过世代相传的直系后裔传承，虽然偶尔也会被他们分享给其他人。
Reduce the velocity of your falls by a g: 將下落速度大幅降低，或是如果你超厲害的話能夠降成零。
Ascend even the most sheer wall with eas: Ascend even the most sheer wall with ease as you cling to surfaces.
Mark a particular patch of ground to all: 在一块特定的土地上做上标记，这样你以后就可以回到那里。

You shout out the word of recall and sud: 你喊出召回词汇，突然你就到了别的地方。
A simple but powerful spell, Mageshield: A simple but powerful spell, Mageshield will render the caster immune to any single attack.  It is indiscriminate: whether hit by an anti-tank missile or the caster stubbing their toe, it will absorb all energy of the attack and then fade.

An iconic Stormshaper spell in the popul: 一个众所周知的标志性“风暴塑造者”法术，其效果正如你所期待的那样：从指尖射出闪电。然而，这种闪电比大多数闪电更具指向性，能够沿直线穿过大多数非实体目标。

As the sound of the spell moves out of y: As the sound of the spell moves out of your mouth, it creates a crushing shockwave that shatters everything in its path.
Briefly become lightning to teleport to: 短暂地变成闪电传送到选定的地点，忽略路径上的所有障碍。
Enhance your sight with your powers whic: 运用你的能力增强你的视觉，使你能看见周围同源能量的生物。这种增强的感知速度使你能察觉到更多即将到来的攻击，从而有机会尝试做出额外的格挡或闪避。
Your hands start to store a vast amount: 你的双手开始蓄积庞大的能量，并在每次攻击时释放。你感觉到随着对该法术掌握程度的提高，其威力将会更强。
A spell designed for scholars who have r: 一项专为初学风暴塑造者设计的法术，使他们能够减少自己新学到的经常不稳定能力可能对自己造成的伤害。
Summon a Teravolt, a small, semi-intelli: 召唤一只特拉伏特，一只小型、半灵智的灵魂体，它会锁定敌对生物并在接近后爆炸成为一团巨大的电火花云。
Call out to the sky spirits for aid and: 向天空中的神灵求助，请他们帮你躲避敌人。 大雾会遮住你的通路，但你自己没有任何特殊能力看穿大雾。
Compress the fury of hurricane winds int: 将狂暴飓风的狂风压缩成薄薄的狂暴气流壳，环绕在自己周围。这样你就不容易失去平衡或被击倒，有时还能将攻击者扔出去，但旋风的声音很大。
Someone's personal notes were added to t: 这个法术上添加了某人的个人笔记。你能确定不管是名字还是功效都已经变了。
Increase the volume of the caster's voic: 增大施法者的声音音量，使其说出的每个字如同雷霆般回荡。作为一项实用的附加效果，此法术使施法者对因噪音过大导致的听力损伤免疫。
Technomancy is the magic of human potent: 科技魔法是人类潜能的魔法，这个法术能增强你和附近盟友在许多领域的潜能。
Creates a magical field that hides your: Creates a magical field that hides your visual presence to others.  Colloquially known as invisibility, but without all the science mumbo jumbo.  Attacking a target will break the invisibility.
To the outside world, your body fades aw: 對外部世界來說，你的身體逐漸消失，你不復存在！

This ritual inscribes circuit-like ley-l: This ritual inscribes circuit-like ley-lines into a rune, attuned to Technomancers.  You can use the rune as a catalyst for recipes.

You overcharge your bionic energy throug: 你将体内的生化能量过载并导入你仅余的灵脉中，并将其导引至脸部射出。

This spell goes even further beyond, lau: 这个法术比之前更进一步，它所射出的飞刀速度快到能够直接穿透目标。
Overload the target, stunning it briefly: 使目标超载，短暂眩晕。 该法术最初是在罗马帝国时期开发的，用于对付失控的傀儡，到了现代，人们发现该法术对机器人和机械也同样有效，因此变得更加流行。
One of the most widely-known pre-modern: 这是最广为人知的前现代技术咒语之一，可以让技术人员进行远距离通信。 在古列尔莫-马可尼发明了收音机之后，它的使用迅速减少，因为突然之间，每个人都可以监听他们的谈话。
For the technomancer with no enhancement: For the technomancer with no enhancements, this spell summons a power supply composed of pure mana that can be used to charge any compatible device.  Just keep it on your person and it will continually recharge your electronic devices until the duration expires.
Using the principles of what were once c: 利用曾经被称为“伏特电弧”的原理，你可以将金属电热到足以将其焊接在一起。
This fancifully-named and lengthy spell: 这个法术名字花哨、耗时极长，实则能为电池或电网恢复电力。在电力普及之前，它只是种深奥冷门的奇术；即便后来电力普及时，化石燃料的能效优势仍使其长期处于边缘地位。
This spell grants the caster an intuitiv: 该咒语能增加施法者对电子产品和计算机的知识，使其使用、维修和制造更加轻松。
Enchant an item so that it is capable of: Enchant an item so that it is capable of drawing power wirelessly through the air from a compatible power source.
By etching tiny runes on a lens of great: By etching tiny runes on a lens of great quality and infusing it with their magic, the caster can use the lens to see further than even the finest mundane binoculars.  Unfortunately, the arrangement is unstable and the lens will disintegrate after a time.
This lens can see farther than ever! No: This lens can see farther than ever!  Now you know this spell like the back of your hand, and have started to design your own version.

The pinnacle of technomantic improvement: 科技魔法强化的巅峰，这个法术能极大增强你在所有领域的潜能。

This is a magical device that can take t: 一个能够变形成各种工具的魔法装置。当它未被使用时，它看起来就像一把简单的螺丝刀。
Artificers have a special pocket dimensi: 机关术师们能通向一个特殊的口袋维度，其中有把魔法工具，可以完成各种各样的工作。你可以暂时召唤出这个工具供你使用一段时间。
You overclock your flesh and bionics, ch: 你将自身肉体和生化插件超频，充能速度如此之快，以至于摩擦都能点燃四周的空气，给对方来一记碎骨拳。
Heals a little bit of damage on the targ: 醫治目標的傷害，回復少量的生命值。

Welcome to Mind Over Matter, a psychic p: Welcome to Mind Over Matter, a psychic powers mod for Cataclysm.  This mod adds psionics to the game based on classical concepts of mental powers.  Incinerate zombies as a pyrokinetic, avoid bullets by peering into the near future as a clairsentient, recharge your car as an electrokinetic, run so fast you can run on water as a biokinetic, and more.  All these powers are available to you.
And to your enemies. The player is not: And to your enemies.  The player is not the only one with psionics.
Psionics are different in several ways t: 灵能与《大魔法》中的魔法在几个方面有所不同。首先，所有灵能都需要消耗耐力而非魔力之类的外部资源，这意味着一名灵能者耗尽能量后，只需稍作喘息便可完全恢复。其次，灵能的强度会随你的智力、虚空同调等级（见相关词条）以及能力等级而提升；其等级上限同样受此影响，最高可达你智力的1.5倍。第三，持续时间较长的灵能必须保持专注才能维持，而受伤、触电或吸入有毒烟雾等负面效果都可能让你中断专注。如果你在悬浮或维持控火护盾抵御火焰时中断专注，你不仅会身受重创，甚至可能要重返角色创建界面。
Finally, psionics are taxing on the body: Finally, psionics are taxing on the body and each usage of a power requires caloric expenditure.  This is treated the same as any other caloric expenditure, causing weariness when it grows large enough and eventually rendering you exhausted.  Psionics are work.
Mind Over Matter is designed to be as co: Mind Over Matter is designed to be as congruent with vanilla as possible, so psionics are rare and most evidence of their existence is confined to secret locations.  It may take some time to gain psionic powers if you start without them.  This is intended.
One last thing: remember to bind the Sup: 最后一件事：记得绑定超自然能力快捷键来使用你的超能力！
There are nine paths of psionics in Mind: 在《心胜于物》中，灵能共有九大分支，具体如下：
1) Biokinesis: Control over physical bod: 1) 炼体：掌控自身的生理过程，例如呼吸、新陈代谢、皮肤弹性或疼痛反应。炼体大师的力量与速度远超凡人想象，他们能于瞬息之间跨越短距，徒手拧动螺栓、拔出钉子，屏息长达数十分钟，并在徒手格斗的各个领域中超越人类巅峰。
2) Clairsentience: Enhanced perception a: 2) 灵视：增强感知，运用超脱于物理层面的感官，并进行短期预知，例如听见超高或超低频率的声音，或是透视墙壁、望见远方。超感大师能够在战斗中预判对手的行动，将所有可能影响远程武器的因素都纳入考量，从而实现完美一击，获得附近地域的幻象，并感知到危险与那些企图伤害他们的人。
3) Electrokinesis: Control over electric: 3) 驱电：掌控电力与部分电化学过程，包括神经元与计算机的运作。 驱电者能够通过触摸电击对手，为随身携带的电子设备充电，击晕或关闭机器人，麻痹拥有神经系统的生物，加速自身或他人的神经反应，并释放出闪电冲击。
4) Photokinesis: Control over light, rad: 4) 控光：掌控光、辐射与无线电波。控光大师能使周遭的空气发光，在自身周围制造幻象以隐藏行踪甚至凭空消失，改变自己的外貌，释放激光，收听无线电广播，以及散发出如正午烈日般的光芒。
5) Pyrokinesis: Control over heat and fi: 5) 焰动：掌控热量与火焰。控火大师能在暴风雪中仅穿一件薄T恤，意念燃木，向敌人释放熊熊烈焰，让火焰之幕环绕己身，以及将一处地点加热到足以熔化钢铁的程度。
6) Telekinesis: Moving objects without t: 6) 念动：无需接触即可移动物体。控物大师能将物体或人抛向空中，踏水而行，创造屏障来阻挡高速攻击，让物体悬浮在身边伴随而行，御空飞行，甚至引发小型地震。
7) Telepathy: Perception and manipulatio: 7) 心灵感应：感知并操纵他人的思想。传心大师能够解读思维，影响他人情绪使其平复，驯服那些通常无法驯服的动物，通过心智回馈击晕并伤害敌人，从目标的感知中将自己抹除，甚至能控制敌人，让他们为灵能者而战。
8) Teleportation: Movement without cross: 8) 传送术：一种无需跨越其间距离的移动方式。传送大师能够：增加敌人周围的相对距离以减缓其行动；缩短自身周围的相对距离，从而在数米之外发动近战攻击；穿墙传送，或从一楼瞬移至屋顶；穿墙而行；远距离传送至曾到访过的地方；以及开启通往虚空的临时裂隙。
Mind Over Matter: Gaining Psionic Powers: Mind Over Matter: Gaining Psionic Powers
There are three main ways to gain psioni: 获取灵能主要有三种途径：在游戏开始时就拥有灵能；找到并使用一枚矩阵晶体；或是在毫无防护的情况下置身于空间风暴的狂暴能量之中。
The first and most obvious is start the: 第一种，也是最直接的方法，就是在游戏开始时就拥有灵能。每个灵能派系都有对应的职业，例如洞察派系的“末日先知”，或是传送派系的“伊兹夸乌特利军团联络官，夜风分部”。此外，每个派系还有名为“初醒者”、“觉醒者”和“飞升者”的三个背景。选择“初醒者”开局，你只会拥有寥寥数种最基础的能力；选择“觉醒者”，你将获得足以媲美游戏中期角色的诸多能力；而选择“飞升者”，你将拥有一整套极为强大的灵能，最适合在怪物难度显著提升或面临其他挑战的游戏中使用。
You can also choose psychic knacks; see: 你也可以选择灵能天赋，详情请参阅其专属的帮助主题。
The second is to find one of the strange: The second is to find one of the strange colored crystals now found in the world, and the third is to stand out in a portal storm unprotected.  Using a matrix crystal works immediately and standing in a portal storm is a small chance each moment, but the effect is the same.  If you succeed, you gain a power path appropriate to the type of crystal, or randomly in the case of a portal storm.  If you fail, you suffer from negative effects related to your failure.  A failed biokinetic awakening will leave you physically weakened, for example, and a failed telekinetic awakening causes unseen forces to press down and inhibit your movement.
Unlike learning spells, psionics are not: 与学习法术不同，灵能的觉醒并非必然。每个新创建的角色都只有一定的几率获得灵能。这个几率因人而异，在创建角色时就已设定，范围可能在50%到低至1%之间。此外，你每多掌握一个派系，学习未来派系的几率就会降低，但绝不会降至零。你可以在角色创建时选择“潜在灵能者”特质，以确保你首次尝试觉醒灵能时必定成功，但这也会影响到后续尝试觉醒其他派系时的收益递减效果。如果你开局就拥有任何类型的灵能，则无需选择此特质，因为开局灵能者默认就是潜在灵能者。
Psionic powers are located in your super: 灵能位于你的超自然能力菜单中，并按派系分类。每个灵能前面都标有[Ψ]符号。
Psionic powers require stamina to fuel t: 驱动灵能需要消耗体力与卡路里。体力消耗量会列在超自然能力界面中，卡路里消耗量则不会，但它会根据能力的掌握难度而变化。此卡路里消耗与体力活动所燃烧的卡路里性质相同，你可以通过运动手环来追踪，并且它的消耗会让你更加疲惫。提升特定能力的等级会降低体力消耗，但不会减少卡路里消耗。
Mind Over Matter: Improving and Learning: Mind Over Matter: Improving and Learning New Powers
Psionics come from within and cannot be: Psionics come from within and cannot be studied by rote repetition from a book.  Furthermore, since they only recently appeared with the Cataclysm, there are no established teaching methods or pre-existing courses.  That means that each psion must figure out how to use their powers themselves.
Every 12 to 168 hours, you gain insight: Every 12 to 168 hours, you gain insight and become eligible to learn a new power, but that doesn't mean you automatically learn one.  Powers in paths you have access to periodically check to see if they are eligible for learning.  This requires insight as well as individual prerequisites that must be met for each power, though there is always a small chance you will have a flash of inspiration and discover a power despite not meeting the prerequisites.
Once you discover a power, you need to s:
发现一种异能后，你需要对其加以研习并尝试摸索出运用之法。这需要通过制作其冥想配方来完成，该配方位于「练习」分区下的「METAPHYSICS」标签页内。这是一次漫长的制造过程（通常需要8至16小时），必须一气呵成，最终以一次对抗性检定作为结束。其判定的公式如下：
你的检定值 = 一个介于0到你的超自然学技能等级之间的随机数(此数不得低于你超自然学技能等级的一半) + 一个介于0到你智力值一半的随机数 + (若你拥有相应的道途专长，则+5) + 随机值(-2,8) + 随机值(-2,8)

对抗值 = 7 + (该异能的难度× 1.5) + 你当前正在维持的异能数量（若你的专注值上限因惩罚而为负，则额外追加修正值）

若你胜出，则成功学会该异能。若你失败，可以再次尝试。<br style="">
Once you know a power, that same contemp: Once you know a power, that same contemplation recipe can be used to improve it.  Simply craft the contemplation recipe and you will begin meditating on the power.  The longer you meditate, the more experience in the power you gain.  You can meditate as long as you want and stop at any time.
In order to focus enough, you will need: In order to focus enough, you will need a matrix crystal, either a drained one or one attuned to the path.  The large crystal structures found out in the world are also sufficient, though meditating near them for too long may have unexpected effects.
One final important note. Since insight: One final important note.  Since insight is singular and used up by the first power you learn, knowing more paths means that you will advance in any individual path slower, since more powers are checking to see if they meet the prerequisites to be learned and lower-difficulty powers check more often than higher-difficulty ones.  Too many paths and it will take you months or years to master a single one.
One major difference in Mind Over Matter: One major difference in Mind Over Matter compared to other mods containing supernatural effects is the concentration system.  By default, psionic powers have no inherent duration; you cannot channel Physical Enhancement and then have it sustain itself the way you could a Bless spell.  You must concentrate on it to maintain it.
Concentration powers have a listed durat: Concentration powers have a listed duration, but they keep going until turned off or until your concentration is disrupted.  Every time the duration on a concentration power is up, you gain additional experience in the power, check for gain of Nether Attunement, and pay the caloric cost.  This is also when checks to maintain concentration are made.
By default you can only concentrate on a: By default you can only concentrate on a small number of powers at once, equal to your intelligence divided by four.  While you can concentrate on more powers than this in emergencies, you have a chance of losing your concentration, and the effects of your powers, that scales with how many powers you are over your limit.  A series of proficiencies exist that can raise this limit, as can other traits.  In addition, many traits or temporary effects can also lower it, such as being set on fire, nauseated, sick, too hot or too cold, having an animalistic predatory mindset due to mutation, and other conditions that would make it more difficult to concentrate effectively.  Some circumstances, such as falling sleep or breaking a limb, will automatically end concentration as well.
As a psion you are not limited by mana b: As a psion you are not limited by mana but must carefully decide which powers are appropriate for any particular situation you find yourself in, since you cannot have them all on at once.
Stamina and concentration are not the on: Stamina and concentration are not the only limitations on your powers.  Another is Nether Attunement, though it is both a limitation and a path to power.
Psionics is the psychoactive power of th: Psionics is the psychoactive power of the Nether channeled by careful concentration.  Repeated use of psionics in a short period of time opens the connection to the Nether wider, increasing the amount of power available.  Higher levels of Nether Attunement boost all characteristics of your powers: range, damage, duration, targets affected, bonus granted or penalty caused, and so on.  At 12, the maximum degree of Nether Attunement, your powers are over five times stronger than with no Nether Attunement!
Nether Attunement has a chance to rise w: Nether Attunement has a chance to rise when using any power or when maintaining concentration on a power.  Higher-difficulty powers have a greater chance of causing Nether Attunement, and using more powers in quick succession also raises the chance.
However, Nether Attunement also carries: However, Nether Attunement also carries risks.  The stronger your connection to the Nether, the more likely that a single stray thought or momentary lapse in concentration causes a disruption in your powers.  This is reflected in a chance of backlash starting at Nether Attunement level 1.  At low levels of Nether Attunement, backlashes are rare and minor: a headache, a nosebleed, or a chill in the air.  They get more serious as your Nether Attunement rises, including muscle weakness, temporarily losing access to your powers, or uncontrollably-increasing Nether Attunement, finally reaching catastrophes like eldritch monstrosities hunting you, an explosion of unearthly lightning, or permanent psychological damage.
Nether Attunement is thus a balance betw: Nether Attunement is thus a balance between raising it to increase the effectiveness of your powers and not wanting it to go too high to avoid a backlash at an inopportune or dangerous moment.
Nether Attunement naturally lowers with: Nether Attunement naturally lowers with time, and other methods exist of lowering it as well.
Psychic knacks are another way of starti: 心灵天赋是另一种以灵能者身份开始游戏的方式，但与觉醒不同。觉醒是人为的，由矩阵晶体或传送门风暴诱发，而天赋则是与生俱来的。拥有天赋之人天生就具备其异能，尽管这些异能可能要到后来才会完全展现。
Psychic knacks are meant to represent th: 灵能诀窍旨在体现恐怖文学中常见的那类通灵者——他们生来就拥有一套特定能力，或许能将其运用得更加纯熟，但却鲜少涉足其他领域。它们代表了那些拥有一两种独门技巧并能善加利用的角色。作为交换，灵能诀窍的掌握难度仅为完整灵能的一半，这使得它们更易于使用，也更不容易受虚空同调的影响。
Each knack is self contained. A knack f: 每一种灵能诀窍都是独立的。“幻色伪装”诀窍能让灵能者融入周遭环境，而“心智感知”诀窍则能让其定位附近的心智，仅此而已。他们并非真正的控光者或传心者，也不会获得任何新的能力。此外，这些诀窍似乎会干扰矩阵和传送门的觉醒过程。角色掌握的诀窍越多，觉醒为灵能者的难度就越大。但是，一旦你成功觉醒，任何相应的诀窍（如果适用）都会转化为你所属流派的能力，你也将获得学习新能力的资格。

On this world, though, you don't think the M12's lethality or lack thereof is going to be much of a concern.

At 0411 this morning, a GLASS ANVIL math:
At 0411 this morning, a GLASS ANVIL mathematician seconded to XEDRA-40 discovered an anomaly in one of the returning immersion teams during a routine random security scan.  While monitoring Dr. Mahika Mittal, the mathematician suddenly screamed and grabbed their head before collapsing to the floor.  In the ensuing confusion, Dr. Mittal attempted to grab Sgt Adams's rifle before making a gesture and "causing the temperature in the room to drop to freezing".  Following this, Dr. Mittal grabbed Dr. McDowell and dragged him back through the still-open dive aperture just before it closed.  An attempt to reopen the aperture to the previous destination was unsuccessful at producing a stable connection; further efforts are ongoing.

When awakened, mathematician U72 stated that during her attempt to make contact she felt "Something cold, icy, like a glacier.  Inhuman.  It wasn't Dr. Mahika, it was something that looked like her, or had taken her place or…I don't know."  When told that Dr. Mittal had escaped, U72 was emphatic that it (she only ever used the word it) had to be captured for study and to prevent similar incidents from happening again.

Questioning of the other dive team members is ongoing.  None of them said Dr. Mittal showed any suspicious behavior either before or during the dive.

M33: "Uh, okay.  Well, it's hard to describe this, you know, but a normal…sorry, sorry, a standard person has a kind of glow to them.  If they're sick, or tired, or injured in some way, it affects the glow.  [REDACTED]…oh, sorry, I mean, uh, the CE473 had that same glow but it was muted"
Interviewer: "Muted?"
M33: "Like, the glow was just…lower, you know?  Like she was sick or something, but she wasn't.  I couldn't find anything wrong with her at all.  I did a full scan, as much as I could, you know, and she was in perfect health.  Better, even.  The, uh, CE473 is in her mid-40s?"
Interviewer: "That's correct."
M33: "I never would have believed that if I wasn't told it.  She doesn't just look good for her age, she's physically younger."
Interviewer: "What was your impression of the subject on your second examination?"M33: "Oh, at the end of the day?  Well, I'm not sure how to describe it, she was…red."
Interviewer: "What do you mean by that?"
M33: "Yeah, like she was even paler than usual and there were these kind of red streaks.  And it felt, uh…"
*fifteen second pause*

Interviewer: "Please continue.  Your impressions are very important to the success of the experiment."
*six second pause*
M33: "Hungry.  It felt hungry."

In the interests of testing Dr. Al-Masri:
In the interests of testing Dr. Al-Masri's hypothesis, we assembled a group of NOBLE HORIZON and GRAY DAWN mathematicians and had them both attempt to conduct a simple number guessing game.  Melchior provided a six-digit number and both teams attempted to guess it.  GRAY DAWN were competitive when the number was overseen by a third party, as expected, but when both teams were provided with a terminal interface and instructed to enter their guesses, GRAY DAWN scored no better than chance.  On the other hand, NOBLE HORIZON consistently managed to guess at least three digits and successfully guessed the entire six-digit sequence twice (out of ten total sequences).  This disparity was maintained when both groups were placed in empty rooms, instructed to write down their guesses on a sheet of paper, and place it into a box before leaving the room.  Finally, NOBLE HORIZON attained a better than chance score on the final test, when both groups were instructed to guess the sequence before Melchior was asked to provide a sequence.

This leads to two conclusions.  The first is that the alarmists are wrong; Melchior is not secretly harboring a genius intellect and plotting to control XEDRA from within, it is a computer, capable of processing vast amounts of data and using Netherum mathematics to process that data much faster than would otherwise be possible.  The second is that while GRAY DAWN requires a specific source from which to attain new information, NOBLE HORIZON does not.  Even in situations where no information transfer would be possible, such as the final two testing scenarios, NOBLE HORIZON still had a better-than-chance rate of correctly determining the sequence.

How does CRYPTIC FORGE control darkness?:
How does CRYPTIC FORGE control darkness?  Darkness is not a thing, there are no "skotons" that they could emit to cancel out existing light, but that seems to the casual observer what is happening.

B81 was instructed to cancel the light within a one-meter area in the center of the testing chamber.  The lights were extinguished and blackout curtains hung over all observation windows.  The area was first exposed to candlelight (12 lumens), showing a distinct border of the area.  A flashlight (350 lumens) was trained on the area as well, with a similar effect, though the directional light from the flashlight was sufficient to demonstrate that light did not penetrate the area.  A high-powered flashlight (6000 lumens) shown from the corner illuminated most of the testing area and clearly delineated the borders of the area, as well as casting a shadow on the wall opposite of the light source.  Finally, the blackout curtains were removed and, after instructing B81 to close their eyes, a floodlight (118K lumens) was shone on the area, again to no effect.

The initial hypothesis, that CRYPTIC FORGE is somehow suppressing or allowing photons to "jump" through the area, is incorrect.  Assuming that conservation of energy is still in effect (since, without assuming that we have no basis to determine anything), it is instead possible that the photons are somehow absorbed by the affected area in a way that does not inhibit movement, in the same way that space seems mostly empty but large amounts of radiation are absorbed by cosmic dust.  Unfortunate that we don't have access to a particle accelerator to test various particles' interactions with the effect.

I have already submitted a proposal to test CRYPTIC FORGE's ability to block microwaves, radio waves, X-rays, and other elements of the electromagnetic spectrum, and am waiting on successful procurement of the necessary equipment.
Adam Brenner
Researcher

I've heard some of the body people say that they have full awareness, like they're concentrating on every part of their body at once, but that's not what it's like for me.  It's more like focusing on something so hard you lose awareness of your surroundings.  I pick a point in space and I concentrate, and it's like I'm being sucked into it.  I just push on it.  I'm not sure how I can describe it better than that, I push on it with my mind and it starts moving, and when I'm aware of the world again, it's on fire.

World on fire.  If I ever get to write about this, that's what I'll call the book.

The researchers ask me how I know how much energy to add, or how I concentrate, and I just know.  There's a reason we call it "awakening."  I don't even need to think about it, really.  Despite the name it's not like mathematics, where you have to figure out 9 time 34 and carry the 3 and so on, it's like riding a bicycle.  Once I got used to how it worked, I can just do it.  It takes seconds, sometimes less.  I just have to put myself into the right frame of mind and the fire comes.

Not sure how useful that is, but it's what it's like.

为什么焰动和念动之间会有区别呢？火不是基础元素，它是热量汇聚的结果，而热量又是分子运动的结果。从原理上，没有理由说焰动不能让物体中的所有分子朝着特定方向运动，从而使整个物体移动，或者说念动不能产生更混乱的运动，从而使物体热量增加。此外，在任何测试中，念动都无法只移动物体的一部分，除非该部分设计成活动部件；可以扳动杠杆，但没法将盘子一分为二。与此同时，除非物体已经着火，焰动也无法减缓物体分子运动来降低热量。

我的理论是，这完全是心理作用。我们都是在现代流行文化和小说中长大的，知道灵能者”应该“具备什么能力，因此矩阵晶体和异界数学将候选人朝着这些预先确定的道路塑造发展出灵能。如果我们能从未曾接触过的部落中请来一位”烟雾引导“数学家，也许他能够使得目标诱发疾病，或者窃取灵魂，根据那个部落自身关于超自然力量的信仰实践。但是，由于我们的候选人来自这样一种文化，即焰动和念动是两种独立的能力，而控土或御骨在小说中非常罕见，因此觉醒的结果是前者，而非后者。

我在此想正式要求我们的项目候选人具有更广泛的文化背景，以测试这个理论。

莎拉，
我读了你的电子邮件，你是对的——如果我们能够很容易找到一个反例，那它就不再是定律了。“牛顿第三猜想”听起来也许并不朗朗上口，但似乎更准确。我们做了很多实验来寻找使用TK的某种后果，到目前为止，除了标准的代谢成本之外，没有其他东西。异界数学是有效的，但这种能量的作用机制尚不明确。我们已经尝试过使用天平或是排水量，但都没有显示出任何可测量的反作用力。这只剩下了以下几种可能：
1）没有反作用力。这将经典力学彻底掀翻，但坦率地说，怎么说我们都快做到这一点了。
2）反作用力施加在其他地方，例如异界。这基本上只是拍脑袋想的，“好吧，我们看不到它，但它一定在那里。”真是如此吗？此外，除非你相信何博士荒谬的“灵魂是异界构造”理论，否则反作用力实际上并没有作用在原点上。
3）反作用力已经按照某种我们尚未测量到的方式作用了，比如，我不知道，也许是DNA损伤或其他微观层面的领域。我们已经进行了全面检查，但没有任何发现，不过我们也不完全确定自己应该要寻找些什么。

老实说，“我们也不完全确定自己应该要寻找些什么”基本上贯穿了整个项目。令人惊讶的是，我们还能够有这么多地发现。

-尼哈

Dr. Richardson,\nPer request, we assesse:
Dr. Richardson,
Per request, we assessed the ability of three JUNIPER GOLD mathematicians to affect very small masses.  Subjects were ordered to look into a microscope at water flora, then at bacterial samples, and then at images from electron microscopes.  While it makes intuitive sense that larger masses would require more effort and control to manipulate through telekinesis, its actual behavior does not always follow logical constraints--see the way that barriers react to external forces.  In this experiment, we found that manipulating water flora was possible but bacterial samples and electron microscopes both failed.  Our initial hypothesis was that direct observation was required, but the bacterial test provided that is not sufficient to explain JUNIPER GOLD's limitations.  It is currently unclear if this is a psychological limitation or something inherent to JUNIPER GOLD.  Further testing with a wider variety of mathematicians is required.
Madeline Robbins
Researcher

One of the major problems with GRAY DAWN: One of the major problems with GRAY DAWN study so far is the need for either line-of-sight or extreme proximity (generally within 2 meters, though certain mathematicians have a range of up to 4 meters), limiting its value in most real-world applications.  We can hardly use GRAY DAWN for long-term communications if 4 meters is the maximum range of effective communication.  However, I am pleased to report that OS812 is successful far beyond our initial expectations.  While the construction requirements are extremely expensive, including, among other things, three active matrix crystals, it increases the range for GRAY DAWN communication up to several kilometers.  While this is still obviously too short to use for most practical purposes, it represents a very promising breakthrough over previous range limitations.

Let's start with the obvious. Teleporta:
Let's start with the obvious.  Teleportation is moving faster than light, by definition.  Even though our most powerful mathematicians can currently only teleport a few grams a few meters distant, we've used slow-motion photography and confirmed that while the transit is not instantaneous, it's still faster than c.  So, as the saying goes, relativity, causality, faster than light travel, pick two, right?  Which are we going to pick?

Well, as much as it pains me as a physicist to say it, relativity, at least as it relates in this case.  Now we have a third domain alongside quantum mechanics and general relativity: Netherum mathematics.  While I hesitate to speculate on something that we have collected so little data on, it is possible that the Netherum provides its own reference frame coterminous with our own (or multiple) realities.  If we built our satellites with matrix technology, would they still need to account for time dilation?  Would relativity override Netherum mathematics in that case?

But to return to the title: there is no evidence time travel is possible despite repeated attempts.  Perhaps if we had a LOST RAIN mathematician capable of moving interstellar distances we could ask them to come back before they left.  Barring that, I'm afraid asking LOST RAIN to retroactively avert any disasters is not on the table.

Testing began with an area two meters sq:
Testing began with an area two meters square, marked on the floor by electrical tape.  A robot set to travel at a constant speed of 0.1 m/s, verified before the experiment began, was set on one side of the testing area before LOST RAIN mathematician D85 used his abilities on the area.  The robot traversed the space in 16 seconds, verified by both its internal measuring software and external measurements.  We repeated the experiment with a request to extend the relative distance, causing the robot to take 25 seconds to traverse the space.  It is currently unclear whether the disparity in relative distance change is a property of LOST RAIN itself or of D85's abilities.

The only difficulty was caused when Dr. Caldwell crossed through the marked space before D85 had ceased maintaining the distortion and almost immediately collapsed.  She was rushed to the infirmary but in the end was discharged after tests showed that she had fainted but suffered no lasting damage.  Dr. Caldwell explained she had experienced severe vertigo on entering the area, possibly caused by a defect in proprioception caused by actual distance being different than perceived distance.  I have submitted a proposal to further test this characteristic of LOST RAIN--see attached.

Initial testing shows that the rate of awakening from matrix crystal exposure is just over 10%, generally with no side effects.  Candidates that failed to awaken complained of headaches and bad dreams but the effects rarely last longer than a week (see fig 4).  In approximately 15% of cases, however, awakening causes serious side effects including hallucinations, high fever exceeding 39.5°C, muscle tremors, unconsciousness, disassociation, and amnesia.  This can occur in either successful or unsuccessful awakening and is a serious danger in certain cases (e.g. incident reports ID39483 and IC49378).

Multiple awakenings are not cost-effective.  Despite a wide range of candidates and repeated attempts, only two incidents have ever occurred and no specific commonality between the mathematicians other than gender exist.  No further attempts should be made until a similar effectiveness to initial awakenings has been achieved.

In-phase awakenings show variable efficacy, sometimes much lower or much higher than normal.  Efficacy is in general consistent within each plane, though some planes show variable efficacy.  Plane 398RG shows 99% efficacy; however, side effects rise to 85% of cases and so further experimentation with 398RG is prohibited.  Melchior has so far been unable to find any specific characteristics of a plane that would lead to greater or lesser efficacy.  Further testing and sampling are required.

Adds item difficulty settings that reduc: Adds item difficulty settings that reduce the spawn rates for common item categories without reducing rare items.  See EoCs.md for category breakdowns and customisation or EoCs.json for exact numbers used for each difficulty.
Most vehicles spawn damaged and without: Most vehicles spawn damaged and without fuel.  Intact cars now are much, much harder to find, though not impossible (Originally the "Cars to Wrecks" mod).

Makes wooden walls hard to set on fire.  Fire is a very powerful out in alot of situations, this tries to make it slightly less abusable.
Returned CBM loot in most places it was: Returned CBM loot in most places it was removed from (electronic stores, toxic dumps, sewage treatment plants etc).
Returned some cut vanilla content, inclu: Returned some cut vanilla content, including, but not limited to: laser turret (rewrote description to mention it's working not on the solar panels, but rather on compact yet powerful storage batteries; updated drop list to reflect that), chickenbot, tankbot and tripod and made it spawn in some military locations, moose's legendary aggression and flaming eye's ray of destruction.  Removed flaming eye's STARE attack.  Added almost identical monster - staring eye with STARE attack.
No Hope adds 3 difficulties that allow y: No Hope adds 3 difficulties that allow you to pick between increasingly more harsh multipliers to spawn rates split by item category intended to make basic survival less trivial and progression slower and in turn require more exploration leading to greater risk while less powerful without decreasing the spawn rates of items such as mutagens and bionics that are intended as rewards for exploring more dangerous locations and are already rare and as such shouldn't be punished.
The difficulty options can be used along: The difficulty options can be used alongside the regular item spawn rate setting if desired with expected results.
For exact numerical breakdowns of the op: For exact numerical breakdowns of the options see difficulty_options.json along with DIFFICULTY_OPTIONS.md for a barebones breakdown of which categories are affected and why.
If you wish to change the selected optio: If you wish to change the selected option on an existing save you can do so by binding the debug menu then navigating to debug menu -> Game -> Activate EOC -> EOC_NH_set_difficulty.  This notably won't change already generated item spawns anywhere that your reality bubble has touched.

 如果你死亡，你将免于死亡并返回岛屿，但你将失去所有携带的物品。 

进行探险、完成任务、储备补给、升级这座岛屿，并使用你找回的装备为下一次外出做好准备。重复此过程，直到你变得势不可挡！ 祝你好运。

在探险中死亡会让你传送回安全区，但你将失去你随身携带的所有物品。在家里备好下一次的装备，这样你就可以更快的出发！

时间限制是以翘曲脉冲的形式实现的，它会定期击中你。8次脉冲后，你将遭受翘曲失调，你的属性值会随着每一次脉冲而迅速下降。12次脉冲后，你的肉体开始崩溃，在你死亡前会持续受到伤害。返回安全区以重置！

某些升级可以解锁新的探险种类，或提高你的生存能力。
After you have unlocked them, missions a:
在解锁任务之后,每次探险开始时都会随机生成任务。这些任务主要是找到并消灭特定敌人,返回安全区后所有未完成任务都将自动视为失败。失败没有任何惩罚,所以如果任务太远或太困难,你可以在下次探险中尝试更简单的任务。完成任务会获得翘曲碎片奖励。难度更高的任务会获得更多碎片!

你还可以解锁歼灭任务,这需要在单次探险中达到一定数量的击杀目标。这些任务可以在任何地方完成,但奖励的碎片数量较少。

一些升级和配方在你达到更高等级之前可能无法解锁。要提升等级,你需要生存下足够多次的探险,届时你会收到有关可用的升级任务的通知。在你达到更高的等级之前，一些升级和配方将无法解锁。要提升你的等级，如果在足够的多的探险中存活下来，你将收到通知，表明等级提升任务已可用。

In Casual difficulty, time limits are mo:
在休闲难度下，时间限制更加宽松。
每 30 分钟将产生一道翘曲脉冲，这意味着在你每次探险开始 4 小时后会出现翘曲失调，再过 2 小时则将发生翘曲解体。你将会有更多的时间探险，找到撤离点一般也不会是难事。
In Normal Difficulty, pulses occur every:
在普通难度下，每 15 分钟将产生一道翘曲脉冲，这意味着在你每次探险中将有 2 小时时间用于探险、战斗、搜刮、撤离，而此后就会出现翘曲失调，而再过 1 小时后将发生翘曲解体。
这是推荐的难度设置。要撤离并非特别简单，但你一般有足够的时间进行探险。
In Hard difficulty, time limits are stri:
在困难难度下，时间限制更加严格。
每 10 分钟将产生一道翘曲脉冲，这意味着在你每次探险开始 1 小时 20 分钟后会出现翘曲失调，再过 40 分钟后则将发生翘曲解体。你将不会有太多的探险时间，建议将抵达撤离点放在首位。
In Impossible difficulty, time limits ar:
在地狱难度下，时间限制将会十分严格。
每 5 分钟将产生一道翘曲脉冲，这意味着在你每次探险开始 40 分钟后会出现翘曲失调，再过 20 分钟则将发生翘曲解体。仅仅是抵达撤离点几乎就会花掉你的所有时间，你将会与传送病为伴，世界不会对你有一点仁慈！
所有难度设置均为默认。你可以随时和空岛之心交谈以改变难度设置。
Difficulty set to Casual. You can speak: 当前难度为休闲。你可以随时和空岛之心交谈以改变难度设置。
Difficulty set to Normal. You can speak: 当前难度为普通。你可以随时和空岛之心交谈以改变难度设置。
Difficulty set to Hard. You can speak t: 当前难度为困难。你可以随时和空岛之心交谈以改变难度设置。
Difficulty set to Impossible. You can s: 当前难度为地狱。你可以随时和空岛之心交谈以改变难度设置。
Whole Room for a Cost: 使用旋涡代币带回整个房间内
Set the behavior of the return obelisk.\:
设置归源尖碑。
选择这个选项,返回房间里的一切都会回到你的浮空岛上。只要你能到达撤离点,资源通常不会是个问题。

设置归源尖碑。
选择这个选项时，如果你手上有一枚漩涡代币,那么撤离点房间里的一切都会随你一起返回浮空岛。否则,只有你个人携带的物品会被带回去,其他的东西都将遗失。在这种情况下,你可能不得不做出艰难的选择,决定要带回哪些物品。

设置归源尖碑。
选择这个选项时,只有随身携带的东西会与你一起返回。在这种情况下,你可能不得不做出艰难的选择,决定要带回哪些物品。
Warp home behavior set to whole room. Y: 折跃回程的生效范围为整个房间。 你可以使用难度石板随时进行调整。
Warp home behavior set to whole room at: 付出代价后折跃回程的生效范围为整个房间。 你可以使用难度石板随时进行调整。
Warp home behavior set to self only. Yo: 折跃回程的生效范围仅为你自己携带的东西。 你可以使用难度石板随时进行调整。
Set the possibility of returning home wi:
设置在没有撤离点的情况下返回安全区的可能性。
选择这个选项,你将获得一个随时可以无成本返回安全区的法术。施放这个法术需要一分钟时间。使用这个选项将会大大降低模组的挑战性。

设置在没有撤离点的情况下返回安全区的可能性。
选择这个选项,你将获得一个可以通过支付1个翘曲碎片以来返回安全区的法术。施放这个法术需要一分钟时间。在法术施放时,你附近不能有任何敌人,否则法术将无效。

设置在没有撤离点的情况下返回安全区的可能性。
选择这个选项,你将获得一个回程锚点的制造配方。这需要消耗5个翘曲碎片,使用后会施放翘曲回程法术。

设置在没有撤离点的情况下返回安全区的可能性。
选择这个选项,你唯一的选择就是找到撤离点。祝你好运!
Warp Home spell granted. You may find i: 已获得折跃回程法术。你可以在法术施放菜单中找到它。如果你希望更改设置,可以调整难度选项。
Warped Return spell granted. You may fi: 已获得翘曲回程法术。你可以在法术施放菜单中找到它。如果你希望更改设置,可以调整难度选项。
Warped Skyward Beacon recipe granted. Y: 已获得回程锚点配方。你可以在制造菜单中找到它。如果你希望更改设置,可以调整难度选项。
All additional returning options removed: 所有额外返回选项都已禁止。如果你希望更改设置,可以调整难度选项。
在西北方放置一个池塘。
在东北方放置一个池塘。
在西南方放置一个池塘。
在东南方放置一个池塘。
You must be near a water source to creat: 你必须在水源附近才能创造一个翘曲池塘。
Take a full minute of concentration and: 尝试持续专注一分钟，传送回到你的安全基地。
Take a full minute of concentration, pay: 尝试持续专注一分钟并消耗一个翘曲碎片，返回到你的安全基地。
You cannot warp home with enemies nearby: 附近有敌人时无法传送回安全区！
This will warp you home directly, bypass: 这将直接将你传送回家,放弃所有任务和撤离点。你要直接传送回安全区吗?
Designate a hostile for the island to ba: 指定一个敌对目标，由岛屿将其放逐。此法术仅限在岛屿范围内生效。
Designate a tear in reality or a portal: 指定一处现实裂隙或传送门，由岛屿将其弥合。此法术仅限在岛屿范围内生效。
As you return to the island, you notice: 当你返回岛屿时，你注意到北部的贸易摊位有人了。
You haven't selected a difficulty. This:
你尚未選擇難度。這可能是因為你正在玩舊的存檔。

你目前的難度被設為普通。在這個設定中，每次探險你會有4個小時的時間抵達出口並安全逃離。在此之後，你將受到傳送失調的影響，並在逃離之前受到嚴重的 debuff。6個小時後，傳送瓦解將開始，你將迅速流失生命，直到你逃離或死亡為止。
Welcome to Sky Islands.\n\nSpeak to the:
欢迎来到浮空岛。

与空岛之心交谈，你可以获得方位信息、接受任务、管理升级、调整难度设置等等。
Your save was last used with an older ve: 你上次使用的存档是旧版本的浮空岛。正在尝试更新...
Error. Update not applied.\n\nReason: C:
错误。未能应用更新。

原因:在探险期间无法更新。请返回安全区,保存并关闭游戏,然后尝试重新加载这个存档。
Your save was made with a pre-Milestone: 你的存档是使用浮空岛里程碑 1 版本以前的版本生成的,这意味着它缺少升级和空岛之心。正在尝试更新...
Milestone 1 applied. You have been give: 里程碑1已应用。你已获得一个空岛之心种子。在你的岛屿上激活它就可以创建新的空岛之心。与空岛之心互动以选择设置。
You have been retroactively awarded <glo: 根据你过去成功的探险次数,系统已追溯奖励给你 <global_val:owed_material_tokens>个材料代币。
The stat stone, healing salve, difficult:
属性石、治愈药膏、难度调节器以及类似的物品已被移除。这些选项现在通过与空岛之心对话来访问。

翘曲背包和快速治疗已过时。如果你已经拥有任何这些物品,它们仍然可以使用,或者回收以获得翘曲碎片。

所有变更都在补丁中说明。
Your save is post-Milestone 1. Skipping: 你的存档是里程碑1版本之后的版本。正在跳过更新版本...
你的存档现在应该是最新的了。
Select Expedition Length.\nNPCs: <global:
选择探险时长。
NPCs：<global_val:si_npcs_will_join_raid_warning>加入探险。
挑战模式：<global_val:challenge_mode_warning>
A simple, brief expedition at the normal: 这是一次简单、短时间的普通探险。任务和撤离点将集中在一起。是一个快速获取物资和积累经验的好机会。
A longer expedition that offers twice th: 一次较长的探险，提供两倍的时间。任务点和撤离点将更分散。你将有更多机会进行探险，但也需要更多时间来赶路。任务提供额外的翘曲碎片作为奖励。
A very long expedition that triples the: 一次非常长的探险，将时间限制延长三倍。任务点和撤离点将非常遥远。你将有时间进行活动，但你将花费大量时间在穿越危险地形上。任务提供更多的翘曲碎片作为奖励。
Toggles NPC Mode, changing whether NPCs: 切换NPC模式，更改NPC是否会加入你的冒险。
Toggles Challenge Mode, granting more re: 切换挑战模式，以更难的探险为代价获得更多奖励。将应用随机难度调整。
Arrive in a barren field. This usually: 到达一片贫瘠的田野。这通常意味着降落在空旷的旷野中，但总有机发现自己身处在城镇的一块空地上。
到达一个地下室。这往往会让你出现在郊区的某个地方，但也有其他可能。
Arrive on a building roof someplace. Us: 到达某个地方的屋顶。通常情况下，这意味着有房子，但你永远无法确定。始终比地面高一层。
Arrive somewhere in a hidden government:
抵达某个隐蔽的政府实验室。这是一种高度危险的方法。由于这些实验室的维度屏蔽项目，这次探险将花费 1 个实验室门卡作为开始。
请注意！你将从一个封闭的实验室内开始，所以请确保你有办法逃出去！第二张卡片，用于解锁地面出口，是一个选择。你也可以考虑使用溯返之尘或回程锚点。
Arrive in subterranean science lab.\nBE:
抵达地下科学实验室。
请注意！你将从一个封闭的实验室内开始，所以请确保你有办法逃出去！第二张卡片，用于解锁地面出口，是一个选择。你也可以考虑使用返程粒子或亚空间向天空发射信标。
Arrive in a sprawling lab built around a:
抵达一个围绕走廊而建的宽敞实验室。
请注意！你将从一个密封实验室开始，所以请确保你有办法逃出去！第二张卡片，用于解锁地面出口，是一个选择。你也可以考虑使用溯返之尘或回程锚点。
Arrive in an above-ground research facil:
到达一处地上研究设施。
警告：该设施在“大灾变”中遭到严重破坏，内部环境充满敌对目标。接受并执行此任务前请做好充分准备。
Arrive in a lab within a shipping facili:
抵达运输设施内的实验室。
请注意！你将从一个封闭的设施内部开始，所以请确保你有办法离开！你也可以考虑使用溯返之尘或回程锚点。
You retrieved the warp shards from the s: 你从雕像上取下了翘曲碎片。
Your body shivers slightly as a warp pul: 隨著一股傳送脈衝穿過你，你的身體微微顫抖。另一股脈衝將在 <global_val:readablesicknessintervals> 分鐘後到來。傳送失調還需要 <global_val:readablepulsesleft> 股脈衝才會發生。
Goosebumps cover your skin as a warp pul: 傳送脈衝穿過你的身體，你起了雞皮疙瘩。你的死線只剩下一波脈衝的時間了。
A warp pulse passing through you twists: 一股穿过的翘曲脉冲使你体内的血液翻江倒海，眼睛痛苦地跳动。你逗留得太久了，需要回家了。
A warp pulse shudders through your head: 一股翘曲脉冲像地震般地冲击着你的头脑，你的四肢痛得像要裂开。你需要回家，越快越好。
Another warp pulse rocks through you and: 又一股翘曲脉冲在你体内震荡，你的内脏扭在了一起。 你的存在正在崩坏。 你必须马上回家。
A sickening wet sound rips through you a: 当又一股翘曲脉冲经过，一种恶心的粘腻声音撕裂着你。你感觉到你的身体好像在逐渐裂解，只要你还待在这里那这会是你必必然的结局。如果你还想保住小命，回家，快！
As the warp pulse hits, you realize ther:
当翘曲脉冲袭来，你意识到言语已无法形容你的困境。你的身体正在崩溃成一滩烂泥，血液如藤蔓般扭曲。你所能感受到的只有痛苦。
你不仅要死了，而且会死得很惨。
如果撤离点很近也许还有些许生还的希望，但你距离湮灭已只剩片刻。
It seems the portal couldn't find a vali: 无法找到一个有效的位置。
You're still materializing and not fully: 你还在显现，还没完全显现出来。再过几秒钟，全世界就能看到你了，所以如果你陷入了危险，现在是你躲起来的机会。
You've arrived!\nPress a key when ready:
你已經抵達了！
按下按鍵，將生成隨機任務用於此次探險。此流程可能需要再等一分鐘。
You've returned home safely using a desi: 你已经通过指定撤离点安全回家了。你因此获得了<global_val:owed_material_tokens>材料代币作为成功的奖励。
You've proved you can survive a few excu:
你已经证明你能够在地面存活好几次。翘曲之力正在牵引着你,加快你的脉搏,使你的视线变为红色。这种感觉难以形容。你感到......强大。
空岛之心也许对你还有进一步的用途。

在空岛之心处恢复不再免费。在未来的行动中要谨慎行事。
You've drank deep of the warpstream and:
你已深深地品尝了翘曲洪流的滋味,并且幸存下来讲述这段经历,尽管你独特的孤立使得很难找到听故事的人。这个现实的碎片已经反过来攻击你了,你暂时挺过了这场风暴......暂时
你更加自信、强大。你已经尝到了血的味道。当熟悉的世界再次在你周围现形时,你明白空岛之心必定对你持续的成长感兴趣。
This will teleport you back to your sky: 这将把你传送回你的浮空岛。房间里所有物品都将与你一起被传送回安全区。你准备好离开了吗?
这将把你传送回你的浮空岛。你将消耗你的漩涡代币,以将房间里所有物品与你一起传送回安全区。你准备好离开了吗?
这将把你传送回你的浮空岛。任何不在你身上的物品都将遗失。你准备好离开了吗?
Something is telling you to find this lo: 某种感觉在告诉你去寻找这个地方，但另一种感觉又在告诉你那里什么都没有。
Wait, where is this? What happened? Wh: 等等，这是哪里？发生了什么？我为什么会在这里？
If you want to get home with your stuff,: 如果你想带着你的东西回安全区，你需要到达最近的撤离点。它们是唯一能将你完整地带回你的安全区的东西。
A very small cluster of warp energy has: 一小团翘曲能量在此处留下了一些碎片。你只需找到它们并从雕像上取下即可。附近可能存在危险，但不同于其他大部分任务，区域内没有特殊怪物。低收益但低风险。
You found the statue. Now you need to f: 你找到了雕像。现在你需要找到从它身上获取翘曲碎片的方法。
Kill the warp-draining zombies!: 消滅吸收傳送能量的殭屍！
A handful of zombies are congregating at: 在傳送共振較高的地方，有一些殭屍聚集。消除它們，可以獲得一些極小的傳送碎片作為獎勵。
It's done. They're all dead. Warp shar: 完成了。它們全都死了（這次是真的）。傳送碎片從現實的縫隙中涌入。你的獎勵降臨在你身上。
Kill the warp-draining horde!: 消滅吸收傳送能量的屍群！
A horde of low level zombies are congreg: 一群低等級的殭屍聚集在傳送共振高的地方。消滅它們，獲得一些少量的傳送碎片作為獎勵。
Kill the warp-draining evolved zombies!: 消滅吸收傳送能量的進化殭屍！
A swarm of evolved zombies are congregat: 有一群進化殭屍聚集在一處傳送共振強烈的地方。清光它們，就可以得到中等數量的傳送碎片作為獎勵。
A huge horde of evolved zombies are cong: 一群庞大的进化丧尸聚集在一个翘曲共振很高的位置。消灭它们以获得大量的翘曲碎片奖励。
A swarm of rather powerful zombies are c: 一群相当强大的丧尸聚集在一个翘曲共振很高的位置。消灭它们以获得大量的翘曲碎片奖励。
A swarm of extremely dangerous zombies a: 一群极其危险的丧尸聚集在一个翘曲共振很高的位置。消灭它们以获得大量的翘曲碎片奖励。
A single supremely powerful zombie has b: 在翘曲共振很高的位置发现了一只极其强大的丧尸。碾碎它以获得大量的翘曲碎片奖励。

Welcome to Xedra Evolved, the urban fant: Welcome to Xedra Evolved, the urban fantasy mod for Cataclysm.  This mod adds folklore based enemies, experiences and magicks to the Cataclysm.  Humans who experience particularly vivid dreams might learn how to wield them into strange magicks.  Former Xedra employees include cyborgs with stolen bionics, magick wielders and even a Gracken or two.
The world of Xedra Evolved had decades o: The world of Xedra Evolved had decades of dimensional seepage and places where our world connected to other realities.  During these years before the Cataclysm the world became weirder.  Supernatural creatures from myth and legend returned, visited for the first time or left the shadows.  Some games you'll fight against them.  Some days you may very well be one of them.
There are multiple types of supernatural: There are multiple types of supernatural beings that the player can start as or sometimes become.  It is intended that their abilities cannot be mixed and matched except in very specific circumstances.
Some times you may want to play a normal: Some times you may want to play a normal game with extra enemies and no dream magick, take the Dreamless trait.

If you are interested in starting with s: If you are interested in starting with significant dream magick, look at the four melded task force professions.
To start as a werewolf, newly bitten vam: To start as a werewolf, newly bitten vampire, Lilit, elemental fae, or Chronomancer look at the mod specific scenarios.
There are a number of more mundane/less: There are a number of more mundane/less high powered starts available such as a foreign spy, cryptid hunter all the way to hedge magician and changeling.
Both the Dreamsmith and Mad Inventor cla: Both the Dreamsmith and Mad Inventor classes have research actions that you can perform.  They will often fail, but each failure moves the percentage chance for your next attempt to succeed up until it hits 100%.
Alchemy can be discovered in game. It r: Alchemy can be discovered in game.  It requires some luck to find it in the game world, but if you selected Bombastic Perks mod as an additional mod, you can learn Alchemy easily via the perk system.

An urban fantasy content mod for Agent M: 这是一个以都市奇幻为主题的mod，为穆德探员（电视剧《X档案》主角）而设。为大灾变发生前的时间线加入已经持续数十年的维度溢出。这种溢出分隔了一些比较薄弱的地点，人们可以通过这些地点进入另一个维度，但来自这些维度的东西也会闯入我们的世界。XEDRA扩张成了一大坨官僚部门，同时负责阻止、控制、使用这些薄弱地点，有成功也有失败。本模组包含各种类型的怪物、新的职业和地点、现有技能的新用途、新的推理技能、新的魔法系统，以及多维度大灾变所能提供的各种类型的内容。这是一款科学奇幻色彩浓厚的 MOD，在这里你很可能会遇到超自然怪物，也很可能会遇到不明飞行物、大脚野人和卓柏卡布拉。详情请查看readme.md文件。

You may gain chronal insight in several ways:
 #1: Using any chronomancy spell will temporarily allow you to gain insight on killing any enemy for a short time based on the difficulty of the spell.
 #2: Killing time altered creatures, such as monochrome zombies, will give you immediate insight based on the difficulty of that enemy.
 #3: You will gain a small amount of insight every day, proportionally increased by the amount of negative temporal traits you have.

A heavy, but quick two-legged drone that: A heavy, but quick two-legged drone that holds a massive shotgun system above himself.  Effectively a machinegun with legs.
A tiny arachnid-like bot with three mani: A tiny arachnid-like bot with three manipulators with telescopic razor-sharp blades.
A small doglike bot with bot with a prim: 一只像小狗一样的机器人，头部装备着一个预先设置好的捕熊陷阱。它看起来像一只普通的狗，但却是由金属制成的，而且咬合力更强。
Once the mi-go revealed themselves in th: Once the mi-go revealed themselves in the last days before the Cataclysm they released a number of animals to 'gather specimens'.  This four legged beast resembles a cross between a cat and a monitor lizard, tongue flicking out and splitting into multiple appendages.  Before the tvs stopped working people witnessed these creatures biting and injecting some kind of warping venom into their victims.  The changes that its victims would undergo were quite shocking in those days.
A pink alien that used to be a mi-go bef: 这种粉色外星人曾是米戈，后来才变成了这副人类的拟态。不知它们为了塑造这副形态做出了何种妥协，其结果是身体变得更轻，身高也不及普通男性的腰部。它们“身穿”蜡质的粉色薄肉所构成的衣物，唯一保留完好的米戈特征，只剩下那对龙虾般的巨螯和毫无用处的一对带肋膜翼。无论它们是想用这副形态与人类进行外交，还是纯粹出于对人形的好奇，都不要被其矮小的外形所迷惑，它们的攻击依旧威力不俗。
A dog-sized spider, the air around it ha: 一只体型和狗一般大小的蜘蛛，它周围的空气散发出微弱亮光，可能是由细小的蛛丝反射出来的。
A tall body on four legs, surrounded by: A tall body on four legs, surrounded by a "glitched" aura - it constantly changes its own position.
A humanoid on two legs, this creature sp: 这是一种长着两条腿的人形生物，它的八只眼睛排成一个圆圈，监视着周围的一切。它不时地分成两半，左边的一只处于防御位置，另一只则用它的长拳头攻击敌人。
The body of the duplicator splits in hal: 复制者的身体一分为二！
Their entire bodies\nincluding their bac:
他们的整个身体
包括它们的背部、双手和翅膀
完全充满了眼睛
他们的四个轮子也是如此。
The %s shatter into pieces in silent exp: %s在无声的爆炸声中碎成碎片。
Flying piece of light in a shape of… a c: 一个立方体形状的飞行光？它不断地改变自己的形态，每一次攻击都会将这片空间从现实中撕裂，引发一场荒谬的爆炸。即使它很友好，它的一些行为也无法解释。
A towering swarm of mutated rats, their: 一群變異老鼠， 尾巴揉結在一起形成一個骯髒的肉團。散發出強烈的惡臭。
鼠群從四周竄出於視線之中。
%1$s stares at you and you feel a sense: %1$s stares at you and you feel a sense of doom!
A broken robot, still standing and satur: A broken robot, still standing and saturated with electricity.  Between the shattered dreamdross plates, the ruined armor and the electrical discharges, you can barely see the remains of the machinery that once animated it, and yet it moves on its two feet, albeit like some sort of puppet.
Forged from the wildest dreams and the w: 这只巨蚊从最野蛮的梦境和最恐怖的噩梦中诞生，当它的口器虹吸着空气时，身体也随之膨胀，就像它以某种不可视之物为食。看着它，你感觉意识有些模糊，让你感觉这只怪物正在吮吸的是你的梦。
%1$s buzzes loudly as its speed increase: %1$s buzzes loudly as its speed increases.
%1$s's shell hardens as you prepare to a: %1$s's shell hardens as you prepare to attack it.
%1$s points its proboscis at you, and a: %1$s points its proboscis at you, and a projectile bursts from it!
%1$s hits you with one of its legs with: %1$s hits you with one of its legs with tremendous force.
Nearly seven feet tall and whip thin, th: Nearly seven feet tall and whip thin, this grotesque mockery of a March Lord is wrapped in fiery moonlight.  Moonlight courses its veins as the heart you granted it pulses with power.  Its face is struck in a grimace of pain and its eyes shine with endless hatred directed at you, the one responsible for its current state of agony.
The %s decoheres and is consumed by the: The %s decoheres and is consumed by the moonlight!
%1$s points a finger at you, and a proje: %1$s points a finger at you, and a projectile suddenly appears from it!
A ray of moonlight bursts from %1$s!: A ray of moonlight bursts from %1$s!
Without the moonlight shining on it, %1$: Without the moonlight shining on it, %1$s is weakened!
%1$s lashes out as it attempts to be exp: %1$s lashes out as it attempts to be exposed to the moonlight again!
A large, irregular mass of greenish slim: A large, irregular mass of greenish slime.  It forms tendrils as it perceives you, likely to try and bring you closer of its stronger allies.
A large, irregular mass of reddish slime: A large, irregular mass of reddish slime, forming appendages to bash its targets.  It wanders blindly, waiting for something to come close enoug for it to notice and crush with its mass.
This mass of pale slime quivers as you a: This mass of pale slime quivers as you approach.  Beneath the surface, you see shapes trying to find a way out of it.
%s opens itself, and some small globules: %s opens itself, and some small globules crawl out of it!
This small, swift ball of slime moves to: This small, swift ball of slime moves to attack you without hesitation.  Despite its size and lack of strength, its speed must not be underestimated.
A blazing mote of light, so bright that: 一个炽热的光点，如此明亮以至于无法直视。
You freeze like a frightened rabbit!: 你像只受惊的兔子，呆立当场！
Shiny reflective throwing knife at the r: 閃亮的反光飛刀隨時待命。
The %s stiffens and falls apart into fra: %s的身体一阵僵直，随即崩解成无数碎片。
It would be funny watching a shark swim: 看着一只鲨鱼在空中、树木间和其他物体之间游动，如同穿过水底的海草，还能称得上是某种有趣的场景，如果不是这只鲨鱼就在现实中，并且能够追着你飞行的话。这里的情况明显不对劲。
The tail of this snake doesn't seem to e: 这条蛇的尾巴似乎没有尽头。很明显，有些地方并不是这条蛇尾巴的一部分，但当你看着它移动时，你只会看到身体的前部向前移动，而尾部永远保持在原地。但这不可能是真的，所以你的眼睛盯着其他地方看时，这条蛇似乎会变回一条长度固定的蛇，不是吗？
A buzzing whining sound accompanies this: 这群松动的牙齿不停地嗡嗡作响。
It is you. It looks like you, it is equ: 那就是你。它看起来像你，它装备像你，它甚至有像你一样的武器。
An almost three-meter tall wall of fur a: 它身高近三米，简直是一堵由毛皮和肌肉砌成的活墙，利爪大如人掌，獠牙足以轻易撕下人的头颅。这只狼人的皮毛上有几道疤痕，你不禁好奇，究竟是何种创伤才能在它身上留下永久的烙印。
%1$s tries to slash your %2$s, but you d: %1$s试图用利爪攻击你的%2$s，但被你躲开了！
%1$s tries to slash <npcname>, but they: %1$s试图挥爪攻击<npcname>，但被对方躲开了！
%1$s tries to slash your %2$s, but fails: %1$s试图用利爪攻击你的%2$s，但未能穿透你的护甲。
%1$s tries to slash <npcname>, but fails: %1$s试图挥爪攻击<npcname>，但未能穿透对方的护甲。
The shadow pack member growls and their: 暗影狼群的成员咆哮着，它身上的伤口正以更快的速度愈合！
A mighty hunter of the People from ages: 一位来自远古时代的强大猎手，旧日族人的一员，如今重获形体，再度投身于大狩猎之中。
One of the children of the night: One of the children of the night
one of the leaders of the people under t: one of the leaders of the people under the hill
A magickally-animated mass of thorns, bo: 一团由魔法驱动的活化荆棘，为屠戮吸血鬼而生
a variety of creatures that have partake: a variety of creatures that have partaken of the unholy blood of the vampyr
a being who devoured vampires to become: a being who devoured vampires to become better at killing them.
creatures made from dreams, technically: 由梦境创造的生物，理论上讲并非活物
A creature that can take more than one f: 一种可以随意变换多种形态的生物
Clad in ancient armor and with a mace in: Clad in ancient armor and with a mace in hand, this warrior was summoned by magic to defend you.
Clad in ancient armor and with a battlea: Clad in ancient armor and with a battleaxe in hand, this warrior was summoned by magic to defend you.
Clad in leather armor and with a spear i: Clad in leather armor and with a spear in hand, this warrior was summoned by magic to defend you.
Clad in leather armor and with a sword i: Clad in leather armor and with a sword in hand, this warrior was summoned by magic to defend you.
A shadowy figure, only barely visible as: A shadowy figure, only barely visible as more than a mist, but the silhouette of armor and weapons are obvious.
A creeping mobile plant, as tall as a mo: 一种蠕动的移动植物，高如驼鹿。它有一根被树皮覆盖的茎，支撑着一个开花的头部，里面隐藏着一根麻痹性刺。当它移动时，叶子似乎会弯曲让路。
What stands in front of you is one of th: 站在你面前的是你见过的最健康的丧尸之一。 如果不是因为它步履蹒跚，口中渗出黑色的软泥，你甚至会认为它是人类。 这具丧尸的每个部分，甚至它的衣服，都染上了某种灰色，每隔几秒钟就会闪烁一下。
%1$s flickers and all of its injuries di: %1$s flickers and all of its injuries disappear!
This zombie is partially obscured by the: 这只丧尸遮掩在周围扭曲的灰色空气内。 据你所见，它身上没有一处伤口，以比其它丧尸快得多的速度行动。 每隔几秒钟，扭曲的空气就会涌动一次。
Every bit of color around this zombie ha: 这具丧尸周围的每一点色彩都被抽走，变成了扭曲的灰色。 与它健康、完整的外表不同的是，周围的环境似乎在慢慢被它侵蚀，甚至在它飞快地移动走后也是如此。 它每隔几秒钟就会剧烈地闪烁一下。
The ground around %1$s starts eroding in: The ground around %1$s starts eroding into nothingness.
A rotund human body, bloated beyond beli: A rotund human body, bloated beyond belief.  Its entire body is tainted gray, and it seems to emit a pulsating distortion that saps color from the world around it.  Every few seconds the world around it seems to freeze, and its likely that any damage will easily detonate the distorted time the zombie barely holds within itself.
This armored soldier zombie appears to h: 这个浑身装甲的士兵丧尸曾经似乎是某个特种部队的特战队员，装甲上写有“OA”两个大字。它的故障设备偶尔会释放出一连串火花。
Your heartvines twitch as the vampire di: 吸血鬼死去之时，你的心藤随之抽动，但很快又沉寂下来。它们需要更多的元素之力，方能将吸血鬼之血催化为新的荆棘巫术。
Your hands need to be free to summon the: Your hands need to be free to summon the heartwhip.
The heartwhip retracts, slithering throu: The heartwhip retracts, slithering through your grip and back within your body.
You dream of chalices of flowing blood a: You dream of chalices of flowing blood and endless night, of the moon filling half the sky, of red eyes in the dark, when your dream is interrupted with the sensation of dozens of thorns pricking you from the inside.  You wake with a start, in terrible pain…but free of your curse.
You have terrible dreams of blood and da: 你被卷入充斥着鲜血与黑暗的噩梦，梦中不时被荆棘刺痛的感觉惊扰。若想涤净身上的诅咒，你必须去往荒野之地入眠。
You feel a burning sensation in your vei: 你感到血脉中传来一阵灼痛，心藤也随之抽动。你已被嗜血者的污秽诅咒所感染。速去荒野休憩，让你的心藤净化诅咒，否则心藤的净化之举恐将你一并毁灭。
你的血脉传来一阵灼痛，心藤也随之剧烈翻腾。
睡梦中，你的心藤剧烈振荡。
睡梦中，你的心藤抽动了一下。
After being infused with the power of na:
After being infused with the power of nature, part of the ritual of the Bloodthorne Druids was the implantation of a symbiotic plant.  You aren't sure where it came from or what its natural habitat is, but now it's a part of you.  You require slightly more food and water than normal to feed it, but have the power to fight back against the blood-drinkers.

Vampire blood taken from their dying hearts and stolen power from the wood-elemental fey will both fuel your Heartvines.  Enough of both will allow you to unlock new gifts.
This is the school trait for Bloodthorne: This is the school trait for Bloodthorne Druids.  You shouldn't see it directly.
You can cause a sudden outgrowth of your: You can cause a sudden outgrowth of your Heartvine into a living whip-like weapon, ready to scourge the undead.
A vine erupts from your arm and wraps ar: 藤蔓从你手臂迸发而出，缠绕你的手腕，随后贴合地融入你的掌心。
The first principle of defeating the blo: The first principle of defeating the blood-drinkers is to avoid losing your blood.  While standing on natural foliage, you can use this spell to replenish any lost blood.
When bleeding, your heartvines can pull: When bleeding, your heartvines can pull the wound closed and stop it.  This is painful, but will prevent further bleeding.  If there are any vampires or their servants nearby, the heartvines will also lash out at them as they pull the wound closed.
The most insidious threat the blood-drin: 吸血鬼最隐蔽的威胁是他们的状况具有传染性，因此他们会将那些反对他们的人转变为他们的同情者。你的心藤肯定会阻止这种结果，但你仍然必须保护自己免受诅咒。在野外时，你可以利用野性的力量来保护自己。
You can bring the fury of nature to bear: You can bring the fury of nature to bear on your enemies.  When a target is in thick foliage, you can cause the plants to grow long thorns and pierce them.
The forest spirits gain constant power t: 森林精魂能通过与荒野的连接汲取源源不断的力量。血荆棘德鲁伊虽无此等紧密的连接，却能暂时借用这份力量。你可以提升自身的力量、敏捷和生命值。身处荒野时，该增益会得到增强。
Your heartvines frequently cause you pai: Your heartvines frequently cause you pain on their own, to say nothing of the wounds you suffer fighting the vampires, but now it doesn't seem to affect you as much.  Your strength, dexterity, and speed are penalized less by the pain you feel.
Thornwitchery draws its power from the w: Thornwitchery draws its power from the wild places, and while there you grow stronger.  Your mana recovery is increased when in the wilderness away from civilization.
Your heartvines have grown enough that y: 你的心藤已经成长到足以在你周身延展出无数藤蔓。这些藤蔓会自动反击攻击者、守护你、在你双手无暇时辅助施法、让你能抓住着力点从高处降下，并在危险临近时向你发出警示。
A multitude of vines burst from your fle: 无数藤蔓从你的肉体中迸发而出！
你的藤蔓猛然挥出，抽向攻击者。
Vampires are known for drinking blood, b: 吸血鬼以饮血闻名，而草木则会汲饮任何渗入土壤之物。此术会牵引你周遭区域内所有泼洒于地的血液，令其通过根系被你的心藤所吸收，从而治愈你。
The forest spirits will not answer your: 森林的精魂不会回应你的呼唤，但你的心藤会。立于草木丰茂之地，你便可活化一团扭曲的荆棘，令其攻击你的敌人。
The sap that flows through your veins ha: 流淌于你脉管中的汁液已然变得浓稠，你的心藤会尽其所能将其保留在你体内。你的流血速度减缓了。
When one of the blood-drinkers or their: 当一个吸血者或他们的仆人在青翠的土地上时，你可以让一团巨型荆棘生长并囚禁他们。
You have an intimate sense for the flow: 你对时间的流逝有着敏锐的感知，并能运用自己的力量操控时间。 激活这一特性，就能消耗得到的洞悉。
You have suffered a time looped wound, f: 你有一个时间循环的伤口，导致你不得不反复忍受之前的伤害。 每隔 24 小时，你就会被一把不存在的匕首刺中。
Your timestream remains slightly slower: 你的时间流比基准现实稍慢。 你的行动速度慢 10%。
Your chronomantic powers have inherent i: 你的司辰能力有固有的不稳定性。当你试图长时间保持它们时，你的能力可能会在某一刻突然失效。
Dreamers are people who are able to tap: 梦行者是那些能够利用梦想和附近维度的力量并创造奇妙效果的人。他们甚至可以将一些梦想材料引入我们的世界，用它来建造其他东西。有时，他们会听到外界提供帮助和礼物的声音，只要有足够的力量，梦行者就可以将它们从远处拉出来。他们的魔力恢复受情绪控制，强烈的情绪（无论是积极的还是消极的）对于他们补充魔力储备是必需的。他们的力量随着他们的自然感知和智力而变化。
These people are aware of this cross-dim: 这些人意识到这种跨维度的污染，虽然他们不能把任何东西拉过来制造新事物，但他们可以吃掉他们在我们的世界中发现的任何不属于他们的东西，并从中获得能力和力量。 它们魔力总量更多，但魔力再生速度更慢。他们能施法将浮梦残渣直接转化为魔力值。 他们的能力与力量和敏捷值成比例。
Dreamsmiths can forge dreamdross into a: 铸梦师可以将浮梦残渣锻造成可以存在更久的形态，并制造出可以修复的永久物品。
The Mad Genius uses their connection to: 疯狂天才利用他们与其他维度的联系来操纵甚至用另一个维度的物理法则来取代这个维度中的法则。他们把玩具和无意义的发明变成了难以置信的复杂和强大的机器，但只是暂时的。
The craft of the wise, provenance of cun: 属于智者的技艺，历史上那些狡猾的男人、智慧的女人、预言家、通晓者、草药女巫和解咒者皆源于此。只要有适当的材料，身处适当的时间和地点，他们就能展现奇迹。
The People gain many powers from the Moo:
人类从月亮那里获得了许多力量，以便更好地在荒野中生存和捕猎。

在月光下，于恰当的时机激活，便可习得一项新的“月之恩赐”。
There is power in the Nether for those w: 幽冥之中自有力量，只待有意志与实力者去夺取，而你正是其中之一。希望你不会因飞得太高而坠入虚空。
The compact bionic command and control i: 紧凑型生化插件的控制指令界面与你的神经系统交织在一起，曾经属于某个改造部落民体内。最好的情况，他们不在这个位面的地球上。
This is an expansion to your Neurobionic: 这是对生化插件接口的扩展。它添加了可以接受数据核心的端口，提供即时熟练度知识。
Odds of gaining a new power are <u_val:d: Odds of gaining a new power are <u_val:dhampir_blood_spent_compare_value_for_powers> in <context_val:target_value>.
You have unlocked a new ability from you: You have unlocked a new ability from your use of your tainted blood.
Your use of your vampiric powers has cau: 你对吸血鬼异能的运用，使你获得了一项新的弱点。
Crimson clouds your vision as you are ov: Crimson clouds your vision as you are overcome with an urge to drink blood.
You have not enough power in your blood: You have not enough power in your blood to sustain yourself.
You feel a wave of tiredness as you allo: You feel a wave of tiredness as you allow mortal needs to assert their will once again.
You extend your arms and push the %s awa: You extend your arms and push the %s away from you!
You lash out and push your target away!: You lash out and push your target away!
你已经觉醒到你的妖精本性。
You live firmly in reality and never exp: 你安稳地生活在现实中，从未体验过在其中做出选择能影响现实的极其逼真的梦境。（你无法经历奇异事件从睡眠获得梦境魔法。）
You feel like you've left behind your ol: 你感觉自己舍弃了自己的旧生命和旧形体。
Who needs weapons? You deal more melee: 谁说要用武器呢？你在赤手空拳不戴手套时能够造成更多的近战伤害。伤害随着你的徒手格斗技能等级提升而提升。
You swallow the potion and feel younger: 你吞下药水，感觉自己更年轻了。尽管当你希望它会过去时，味道却久久挥之不去。
You are a dhampir, the child of a vampir:
You are a dhampir, the child of a vampire.  You have inherited a portion of their vampiric power, as well as the ability to drink blood.  Hopefully you can keep your urges under control.

As a dhampir, your blood naturally slowly fills with power over time, which you can use to fuel your abilities.
You can use the connection of your herit: You can use the connection of your heritage to sense nearby vampires and their minions.
You sense one of the vampires' servants: You sense one of the vampires' servants here.
You open your senses to the presence of: 你开始感受暗夜猎手的存在。
You have a set of small fangs, not as lo: You have a set of small fangs, not as long as a true vampire's, but on the other hand, you can retract them to more easily conceal them.  Activate to extend your fangs.

To produce one unit of stormwrought bloo:
To produce one unit of stormwrought blood, you need twenty-five liters of blood.  Any blood a vampire can feed from will do, but you must not mix different blood types or else the ritual will fail.

This ritual needs to be done within five meters of a tear in reality, or the blood will fail to attune to its energies.

When the ritual will be completed, a storm charged with the same energies will begin.  Stay in it until the blood is simmering and it'll be ready to be used.  Do not worry if it doesn't fully charge the first time for these storms are frequently seen these days.
To extract the two liters of Fae essence:
To extract the two liters of Fae essence the ritual requires, you will need to have one lump of steel and one lump of cast iron on your person or nearby enough to be included in the ritual, Fae parts and a container for the liquid essence.

Iron, and to a lesser extend steel, are anathema to the Fae, a fact that the following ritual takes advantage of to separate the essence from the butchered corpse by temporarily amplifying their Fae-bane properties, pushing the essence out of the remains.

Any Fae part will do, as long as their level of relative physics is higher than nothing.
To create a dream-drainer mosquito's hea:
To create a dream-drainer mosquito's heart, you'll need to gather some doses of lotus blossom, a handful of wyld candies, a small pile of dreamdross and a liter of Fae blood to create the dream-draining catalyst.

Once it is completed, find a mosquito and activate the catalyst while no farther than five meters away from it.  It must be a mosquito, anything else won't work.  The mosquito will then gorge itself on the catalyst and will suddenly transform into a dream-eating nightmare.

Once the dream-drainer mosquito appears, kill it and the heart will be yours.

Be careful, as this mosquito wields powers akin to those of the Eaters of Dreams such as the ability to heal its wounds and throw piercing projectiles at you.
To obtain a moonstruck pearl, you will n:
To obtain a moonstruck pearl, you will need the skull of a March Lord, a bunch of glass shards, a handful of faewild dust, ten kilograms of Fae meat, enough bones to make a makeshift skeleton for that meat, some silver and the heart of a mythic monster.  The skull must be one of a March lord, for only they are resilient enough to contain the tremendous energies you will soon harness.

Once the revenant's effigy is completed, place it outdoors and wait until the full moon shines brightly in the sky.  Only then will you take it in your arms and utter the last few words of the ritual before the Luna-Attuned Revenant rises and reappears near you.

This revenant is a powerful foe, directly fueled by the moon itself and blessed with the ability to always see its foes.  Its attacks are very destructive and hard to dodge but you can severely weaken it by luring it anywhere the moon cannot reach it.  If you do this be warned that it will violently lash out at anything standing between itself and the moon.

Fortunately, the revenant cannot regenerate and its flesh lacks any kind of protection other than needing to be extremely heavily damaged to cause it to decohere and die, granting you the moonstruck pearl.

Remember to quickly kill it, for the sun's rays will instantly slay the revenant, preventing you from obtaining the pearl.  Also keep in mind that the revenant will attempt to take revenge on you for its current state and is likely to priorize attacking you over its own wellbeing.

Call up the essence of an endless snow f: Call up the essence of an endless snow field, shining a moment of brilliant light into your target's eyes and blinding them.  The glamour only works outdoors during the day.  The glamour's duration <color_yellow>is reduced</color> in summer.

Create a minute incision in your target': Create a minute incision in your target's personal timestream, separating their present from their past and thus deleting them from reality in a temporal paradox.  This technique is harder to perform on more powerful foes, and may result in backlash if you are not prepared. Create a long-lasting time loop around y: 在自己身上创造一个可以随时结束的持久时间循环。结束循环会将您重置到循环开始时的状态。
You speed up the flow of your personal t: 你加快了时间在你身上的流动，让你比其他事物更快地行动。此能力将保持激活，直到切换为关闭。
By maintaining a field of destabilized t: 在你的身体周围保持一个失序时间场，使你可以通过正常的攻击来逐渐侵蚀目标。此能力将保持激活，直到切换为关闭。
Stabilize your personal timeline, making: 维持你个人的时间线的稳定，使你免疫周围时间变化的负面影响。此能力将保持激活，直到切换为关闭。
Reverse the entropy on your equipment, r: 逆转你身上的物品上的熵，逐渐复原它所受到的损伤或所消耗的能量。此能力将保持激活，直到切换为关闭。
Sink into a mediative trance where you s: 沉浸在一种冥想的状态中，你不断地改写你当前伤口的因果，有效地治愈你受到的伤害。此能力将保持激活，直到你的魔力耗尽或你的伤口被治愈。
沉浸在一种冥想的状态中，你不断地改写你随身携带的物品的因果，高效地复原它们的破损，变形或是消耗的能量。此能力将保持激活，直到你的魔力耗尽。
Your eyes glow lavender for a moment. N: 你的眼睛闪着淡紫色的光芒。现在你的目光可以穿透最深沉的阴影。
Everything around you faces an existenti: 你周围的一切都面临着生存恐惧，因此行动缓慢。包括那些你通常不认为会有生存恐惧的东西，比如不死生物。目标四肢周围的空气急剧冷却。等级越高，范围越大，影响越久。
The edges of your form seem to blur and: 你身体的边缘看起来模糊扭曲，增加了你在一个回合中所能闪避攻击的次数。

Transports you from one place to another: 将你从一个地方传送到另一个地方，并在终点处造成巨大的火焰爆炸。

This ephemeral blade allows you to defen: 这把短暂存在的剑可以让你用脑海中的浮梦来保护自己！
This ephemeral dagger is powered with yo: 这把昙花一现的匕首由你的内在现实连接驱动，你的魔力池越大，它的杀伤力就越大。
Armor that sits lightly on your body wit: 召唤出一套轻轻盖在你身上的盔甲，几乎没有什么累赘，并且叠加在你所穿衣物的上方。
Attempts to banish things clearly inimic: 试图将明显不符合本地物理法则的怪物驱逐回他们的原始维度。

Using your energy you construct an oddly: 利用你的能量，你制造了一个形状奇特的锤子。你可以用它来粉碎你的敌人，或者粉碎各种障碍。

Create a small token. When used, it'll: 创建一个小标记。 使用时，它会把你拉回到你创建它的地方。
Using your abilities, you compress the g: 利用你的能力，你用纯粹的能量压缩双手之间的间隙，试图构建……某种东西。
Continuously generate short-lived bubble: Continuously generate short-lived bubbles of accelerated time around you, allowing you and anything else that enters to act far quicker than normal.
Two ethereal wings sprout out of your ba: Two ethereal wings sprout out of your back indefinitely until toggled off.  They work as phantasmal pair of wings that can somehow lift your weight even without conscious effort.
